# IPVV Vol 1 — Chunk B: the prostration's meaning, the disciple's eligibility, the Gītā-bhaktas — T1

*Source: M00020 lines 600–900 (continuous). Base: Torella's ĪPK 1.1.1 (the kathaṃcit āsādya
sūtra's commentary continues). Covers: the homage's form, the disciple's eligibility, the four
kinds of bhaktas (Gītā 7.16), the dharma/mokṣa distinction, māyā, śraddhā, and the grammar of
"kathaṃcit āsādya." Max-effort T1.*

---

## The prostration and the eligibility

[The author,] not-abandoning-the-seen (dṛṣṭimanujjhan), [is] the-proper-instructor
(samyagvyutpādakaḥ), it-is-said. The Buddhists-and-the-rest (saugataprabhṛtayaḥ), [however,]
are-the-doers-of-that (tatkāriṇaś ca) and-the-haters-of-that (taddveṣiṇaḥ). And-this, by-me, in-the-
"kathāmukhatilaka," at-length, is-determined; that-very-[one] [is] to-be-sought.

[And,] "seeing-the-unprecedented-homage-form (apūrvāṃ praṇāmabhaṅgīṃ paśyan), someone-might-be-
bewildered (vyāmuhyet)" — with-this-intention (āśayena), the-ṭīkā-kāra, for-the-establishing-
of-those (tatsamarthānāṃ), does: "the-victory-homage-and-the-rest (jayanamaskārādi)." By-the-
"and-the-rest (ādi)" word, the-worship, the-meditation, and-the-rest (vandanapradhyānaprabhṛti)
[are]-taken.

Here, that-which-is-the-rested-in-the-two (dvayaniṣṭhaṃ yat rūpam), [and]-being-made-known-by-
the-one-or-the-other-face (anyataramukhena pratipādyamānam), [is]-to-be-made-to-terminate-in-the-
rest-in-both (ubhayaviśrāntau paryavasāyayitam). "The-pot-shines; the-pot-sees (ghaṭo bhāsate,
ghaṭaḥ paśyati)" — for "making-the-not-shining-pot-shine (ghaṭaṃ nirbhāsamānaṃ nirbhāsayati)"
— this-[is]-the-object-cognition (artha-pratipattiḥ). And-the-prostration, here, [is]-the-
rested-in-both (ubhayaniṣṭhaṃ ca prahvatvam) — and-the-excellence, hence, [is]-its (utkarṣaś ca
ato'sya). That — in-the-use-of-the-"jaya-jayasi-jaya"-word (jayati-jayasi-jayeti-śabda-prayoge),
[though]-set-in-motion-by-the-face-of-the-Lord's-excellence (parameśvarotkarṣa-mukhena
pravṛtte'pi), [yet]-the-lowering-of-oneself-natured (svātmanyagbhāvanātmakaṃ) prostration [is]-
to-be-made-the-object (ālambanīya); otherwise, of-the-excellence, the-non-completion (anirvāha).
Thus, in-the-use-of-the-"namo-namāmi-vande-and-the-rest" (namo-namāmi-vande-ityādi-prayoge),
[though]-set-in-motion-by-the-face-of-the-reflection-of-the-lowering-of-oneself
(svātmanyagbhāvana-parāmarśa-mukhena pravṛtte'pi), [yet]-the-rest-in-the-Lord's-excellence
(īśvarotkarṣa-viśrāntiḥ) [is]-to-be-resorted (āśrayaṇīyā). This-both (tad-idam ubhayam), [being]-
one-thing (ekameva vastu), [and]-being-two-partite (dvyaṃśam-api), here-in-this-verse
(iha śloke), around (ā samantāt), [is]-known (veditam), [and]-by-the-word, [is]-made-fit-for-
the-clear-reflection-of-the-whole-audience-to-be-approached (saṃmukhīkartavyasamastaśrotṛ-jana-
sphuṭaparāmarśa-yogyaṃ kṛtam). For-the-implied-by-the-meaning (arthākṣiptaṃ), of-everyone, [is]-
not-the-field (na gocaraḥ).

"The-exceedingly-hard-to-obtain-service (atyantadurlabhaṃ dāsyam)" — by-this "in-some-way
(kathañcit)," [it]-is-said; so, all-the-more, in-the-self-subject (ātmaviṣaye), the-lowering
(nyagbhāvana) [is]-said. "The-great-fruit (mahāphalaṃ) [is]-that-service (taddāsyam)" — [i.e.]
the-Lord's-excellence (īśvarasya utkarṣaḥ); for, from-the-service-ness (dāsatvādeva), in-the-
master, the-Lord (svāmini īśvare), the-obtained (labdhe), again-the-"Lord"-word
(īśvarapadam), [being]-terminated-in-the-māheśvarya (māheśvarya-paryavasitam), [is] alone. By-
the-"great-fruit" word, the-ṭīkā-kāra [shows]: "the-cause-of-the-attainment-of-the-all-assets
(samasta-sampat-samavāpti-hetu) — this-word (idam padam), [being]-the-qualifier-of-the-
recognition (pratyabhijñā-viśeṣaṇam), [is]-also-the-qualifier-of-the-service
(dāsyaviśeṣaṇam)." And-in-the-vṛtti, this-meaning [is]-indicated-by-this: "the-service's-prosperity
(dāsyalakṣmīḥ)." "Of-whom, from-the-Lord's-favor (parameśvara-prasādāt), the-all-assets
(samastāḥ sampadaḥ), [being]-the-prosperities-born-of-the-service (dāsyaprabhavā lakṣmyaḥ),
[are]-obtained (labdhāḥ)" — otherwise, the-taking-up-of-the-"lakṣmī"-word [would]-be-uncalled-
for (asaṅgataṃ), and-the-not-making-manifest-of-the-many-meaning-subject (bahvarthaviṣayatā-
aprakaṭīkaraṇaṃ).

"Even-by-the-speech (vācāpi vā)" — by-the-"also (api)" word, "even-by-the-body (kāyenāpi)"
[is]-to-be-understood (mantavyam). For-thus — the-prostration (prahvatā) and-the-exaltation
(utkarṣaṇaṃ), [being]-of-the-form-of-the-manifestation-reflection (tathā-prakāśa-parāmarśana-
rūpaṃ), in-the-mental-sensation (mānase saṃvedane), [and]-in-the-word-truth (vāktattve), [which-
is]-its-essence (tatsāra-rūpe), [is]-rested (viśrāntaṃ), not-in-the-inert-body (jaḍe śarīre).
Thus — that-which, [being]-made-of-the-mind-and-the-word (manovāgātmakaṃ), [and]-the-not-divided
(avibhaktaṃ) [part] of-the-consciousness-power (saṃvicchakteḥ) — that-alone, [by]-the-devotee-
offering (arpayatā bhaktena), the-all (viśvaṃ) [is]-offered-in-the-Lord (bhagavati bhavati). Thus-
in-the-āgama:

> "And-one's-own-self-he-should-offer (svātmānaṃ ca nivedayet)."

[This]-is-said. "He-should-offer (nivedayed)" — [i.e.] he-should-arrange (arpayet), [and] "with-
the-certainty, [and] he-should-make-knowledge-formed (niścayena vidyāmayaṃ ca kuryāt)" — this-
is-the-meaning. Then, from-the-non-separateness (tannāntarīyakatvād eva), of-the-body, the-
wealth, the-wife-and-the-rest (śarīradhanadārādi), too, the-offering-in-that (tatra arpaṇaṃ) [is]-
born (jāyate). Hence-the-worship, the-oblation, the-bowing-of-the-head, the-eight-limbed-
prostration-and-the-rest (pūjanahavanaśirovinamanāṣṭāṅgapraṇipātanādi), [being]-the-cause-of-
the-inference-of-that (tan-numāna-hetutayā), [and]-by-the-secondary-use (upacārāt), [are]-called-
"homage (praṇāma)," not-primarily (na mukhyatayā).

"True (satyam)" — indeed, [there]-is-the-removal-of-the-obstacles (vighnaśamana), [and]-the-
determined (niyataiva), [this]-is-accomplished (saṃpadyate); but-the-more (adhikaṃ), the-purpose
(prayojanam), [is]-of-the-verse-word's-one-part (ślokavākyaikadeśasya), [which-is]-read-at-the-
beginning (ādau paṭhitasya), [and]-whose-support-is-the-prostration (tatprahvatā-nibandhanasya).
"Even-now (adyāpi)" — [being]-uninterrupted (avicchinnatayā), by-the-door-of-the-entry-into-the-
book (pustakaniveśa-dvāreṇa), the-transference-to-the-whole-heart (aśeṣahṛdaya-saṃkrānteḥ). For-
there-alone, of-the-made-known-ness (āveditatvasya), [is]-the-use (upayogaḥ), not-in-oneself (na
ātmani) — this-is-the-intention (bhāvaḥ). "The-exegete's-position [is]-honored (vyākhyātṛpadam
abhyarhitam)" — previously. "In-the-establishing-of-the-recognition (pratyabhijñopapādane),
indeed, [is]-inferred (anumīyate) the-Lord's-favor (īśvarasāṃmukhyam)" — "preceded-by-the-Lord's-
favor (īśvarasāṃmukhya-pūrvakam)."

**Objection (nanu):** "In-the-exegete (vyākhyātari), this-meaning's-entry (etadarthānupraveśa)
[is]-fit (ucita); but-of-the-listeners (śrotṝṇām), how? For-the-listener (śrotā) [does]-not-
establish-the-recognition (pratyabhijñām upapādayati), [and]-not-the-service (dāsyam)" — the-
inner-separate-reflection (antaḥ pṛthak parāmarśaḥ) [is]-not-fit, from-the-oneness-of-the-
sentence-meaning-reflection (vākyārtha-parāmarśa-aikyāt).

The-listener, too, [at]-the-first-reading-of-this-word (prathamata etadvākyaṃ paṭhanneva), thus-
inwardly-reflects (evam-antaḥ parāmṛśati): "I, now, — from-the-inferred-obtaining-of-the-eligibility-
for-the-teaching-of-such-an-other-worldly-secret (evaṃvidha-lokottara-rahasyopadeśa-bhājanatva-
prāpty-anumitād eva), [and]-from-the-Lord's-favor (parameśvara-prasādāt) — [am]-the-obtainer-of-
the-māheśvara-service (maheśvaradāsyaprāpaṇā-pūrvikā); that-recognition (pratyabhijñā), [which-
is]-established-by-this-exegete (amunā vyākhyātrā upapādyate), — in-that, I-make-the-operator's-
activity (adhyeṣaṇa-tatsamarthācaraṇa-rūpaṃ prayojaka-vyāpāraṃ karomi), by-which-I, [being]-fit-
for-the-attainment-of-the-ācārya-position (ācāryapadaprāpti-yogyatayā), [and]-wishing-the-help-
of-the-people (janopakāramicchan), [would]-make-even-those-people-attain-the-Lord's-service
(tān janān api prāpayya parameśvaradāsyaṃ)." And-thus — even-the-not-wise (avidvān-api), [being]-
with-the-secret, the-praṇava, the-mantra, the-seed, the-meaning (rahasyapraṇavādi-mantra-bījārtham),
from-the-reflection-on-it (tadanucintanāt), obtains-its-result (tatphalam āsādayati). So-the-
disciple, too (evaṃ śiṣyo'pi). For — from-the-non-possession-of-the-ascertainment-connection
(adhyavasāya-yogābhāvād), [and]-being-not-climbed-by-the-intellect-characterized-knower
(buddhilakṣaṇaṃ pramātāram anāruḍho'pi), this-meaning (ayam arthaḥ), in-the-real-knower
(vāstave pramātari), rests (viśrāmyati) — because-of-the-real-one-form-ness (vastuta ekarūpatvāt)
of-that-knower and-that-reflection (tasya pramāturasya ca parāmarśasya).

For — the-same-kind-hard-tracking (sajātīya-haṭhānudhāvanaṃ), in-the-clod, the-water-and-the-rest
(loṣṭajalādiṣu), [and]-even-in-the-great-inert-elements (jaḍeṣu mahābhūteṣv-api), [is]-seen
(dṛṣṭam). And-thus — "the-cognition (jñānam), [being]-the-uncontracted-non-constructive-
consciousness-form (asaṃkucita-nirvikalpaka-saṃvid-rūpaṃ), [is]-the-personal (pauruṣaṃ); [and,]
[being]-the-other-than-the-śāstra, [and]-the-initiation-and-the-rest-means (śāstravyatirikta-
dīkṣādy-upāyakam-api); but-that, [being]-attained-to-the-supreme-ascertainment-position
(aparamadhyavasāyapadaprāptaṃ), [and]-being-the-contracted-consciousness-form (saṃkucita-
saṃvid-rūpaṃ), [is]-the-Buddhist (bauddhaṃ), for-whose-meaning-the-śāstra-and-the-rest [are]-
said (yadarthaṃ śāstrādi ucyate). And-the-ignorance (ajñānam-api), [being]-the-contracted-
non-constructive-sensation-form (saṃkucitāvikalpa-saṃvedana-rūpaṃ), [is]-personal-established
(puruṣaniṣṭhaṃ); [and], [being]-climbed-to-the-contraction-ascertainment-ground (saṃkocādhyavasāya-
bhūmy-ārūḍhaṃ), [is]-intellect-established (buddhiniṣṭham) — in-two-ways (dvidhā), [the]-āgamikas
[think] (manyante)." — here, in-this-matter (atra arthe), the-blessed-Mataṅga-and-the-rest-śāstra
(śrīmanmataṅgādiśāstram) [is]-to-be-sought (paryeṣyam).

That-not-preceded-by-the-intellect (abuddhipūrvakam-api), of-the-disciples (śiṣyāṇām), [and]-
this-reflection-made-sensation (etatparāmarśamaya-saṃvedanam), [is]-born (jāyate), like-in-the-
sleep-and-the-faint (svāpamadayoḥ) [the]-duty-reflection-made-sensation (kartavyaparāmarśamaya-
saṃvedanavat).

## The grammar of "kathaṃcit āsādya"

"Having-obtained (āsādya)" — and "I-would-establish-the-recognition (pratyabhijñām upapādayāmi)" —
[these]-are-the-two-causatives (dvau ṇicau). In-the-vṛtti, too, by-the-word "the-alone-prosperity
(ekākisaṃpadā)," of-the-other, too, that-alone — the-transference-of-the-Lord's-favor-alone-
caused (parameśvara-prasādaikahetukataddāsyasaṃpat-saṃcāraṇam) [is]-indicated — so, [by]-the-two-
causatives' meaning (ṇaij-dvaya-arthaḥ), "having-obtained" [is]-explained. And-"I-would-make-
recognize (pratyabhijñāpayāmī)" — the-two-causatives, in-the-vṛtti — "as-long-as (yāvadeva), [and]
the-inferred-by-the-attainment-of-the-eligibility-for-the-secret-teaching (rahasyopadeśa-
yogyatvāvāpty-anumeyaḥ) the-māheśvara-favor (māheśvara-prasādaḥ) [is], so-long (tāvat), [am]-I-
fit-for-the-making-of-the-self-and-other-help (ātmaparopakāra-karaṇa-samartho'haṃ jāta eva)." "If-
the-god-rained (vṛṣṭaś ced devaḥ), the-crops-are-accomplished (saṃpannāḥ śālayaḥ)" — such-a-
speech (vādam), [is]-indeed-the-disciple's-fit-reflection (ucita eva śiṣyasya parāmarśaḥ). And-
in-truth (vastutaś ca), from-the-one-self-ness (ekātmakatvāt), [and]-of-the-non-interruption-of-
the-manifestation-of-that (tatprakāśanāvicchedasyaiva), [and]-by-the-removal-of-the-delusion
(mohāpasāraṇena), [and]-the-being-made (saṃpādyatvāt), — of-the-author, [however], this-alone-
[is]-the-effort (ayameva udyamaḥ): "the-made-of-my-reflection (matparāmarśamayāḥ), individually
(pratyekaṃ), all (sarve), let-they-be-accomplished (saṃpadyantām)." Like-the-śāstrakāra, [and]-
of-the-exegetes, too, toward-the-disciples, [this]-same [is]-fit (tathaiva yuktaḥ):

> "The-creature, having-attained-my-essence (matsamatvaṃ gato jantur mukta)..."

— this, indeed, in-the-cultivation-of-the-great-pervasion (mahāvyāptibhāvanāyām), [is]-the-alone-
intended-meaning (tātparyārthaḥ). Thus, [by]-the-reflection-on-the-reading-of-the-sūtra-and-vṛtti
(sūtravṛttipāṭha-parāmarśaḥ), [and]-of-the-listeners, too, the-Lord's-approaching
(parameśvara-saṃmukhībhāvaṃ) [is]-given-indeed (dadāty-eva). Moreover — [by]-the-exegete, [and]-
while-reading-the-sūtra-and-vṛtti-book (paṭhyamāne sūtravṛttigranthe), [and]-by-the-door-of-the-
obtaining-of-the-hard-to-get-Lord's-service (durlabheśvaradāsyā-sādanādvāreṇa), [and]-wishing-
this-people's-help (janasya ayam upakāramicchan), [he]-would-establish-the-recognition
(tatpratyabhijñām upapādayatīti) — this-being-such-meaning (evaṃbhūtam artham), [being]-like-a-
reflection (pratibimbakalpaṃ), [and]-by-the-transference (pratisaṃkramaṇa-vaśād) from-the-supreme-
person's-purpose (bimbasthānīyād uttamapuruṣārthāt) [is]-arrived-at (āyātaṃ), [and]-being-made-
known (pratipādya); from-the-sensation-of-the-eligibility-form-ness (adhikārirūpatā-saṃvedanāt),
whoever-is-born (jāyamāno yaḥ kaścit), he, here, [is]-the-to-be-helped (upakārya). Thus — "from-
such-arisen-in-myself (evaṃrūpāt svātmani abhyuditāt), always, I-[am]-the-to-be-helped-jana
(ahaṃ jana upakāryaḥ); the-recognition, [being]-established-by-this-establishing (anena
upapādyamānām upapattyā), [and]-to-be-established (sthāpyamānāṃ), [and]-the-auxiliary-to-the-
obtaining-of-the-hard-to-get-Lord's-service (taddurlabheśvaradāsyāsādana-upayikā) — [this]
recognition-I-would-make-obtain (pratyabhijñām upapādayāmi); I, too, [and]-by-the-establishing
(upapattyā), in-the-heart, [would]-place (hṛdaye sthāpayāmi); [and]-that-establishing,
[being]-ascertained (avadhārayamāṇaḥ)" — this-much (iyat), [is]-the-to-be-understood-ending
(pratipatti-paryantā pratipattiḥ).

## The eligibility and the ladder

Here, first, by-the-skill (kauśalāt), in-the-transference (saṃkramaṇe'pi), the-reflection's-
sameness (parāmarśa-sāmyaṃ) [is]-shown; elsewhere, too, [it-is]-thus. For — this-alone [is]-the-
difference-of-the-eligible-and-the-not-eligible (adhikāry-anadhikāriṇor viśeṣaḥ). For-thus —
"to-you, go, I-teach (tvāṃ gacchety upadiśāmi)" — [this]-scripture-statement (śrutir)
[being]-rightly-understood (yathārtham avabuddhya), "[he]-teaches-me, 'go'" (māṃ gaccheti
upadiśati) — [this]-second (dvitīyaṃ); by-the-transference (pratisaṃkrameṇa), climbing-the-stair
(sopānam āruhya), "[I] go (gacchāmī)" — [this]-third-position (tṛtīyaṃ padam) [being]-obtained
(āsādya), the-sentence-meaning-knower (vākyārthajño) [he]-becomes (bhavati). But-the-not-eligible
(anadhikārī), on-the-first-stair-alone (prathamasopāna eva), rests (viśrāmyati). Thus-this-one
(evam ayam), [being]-about-to-say (vivakṣati) — "[he]-impels-him (enaṃ prerayati)" — [this],
too, [being]-the-having-the-next-stair (bhavatsopānāntara), [and]-the-not-intended-by-the-speaker
(na vakturabhisaṃhitaṃ); in-the-duty-ness (kartavvyatve), [he]-does-not-rest (na viśrāmyati) —
enough-of-the-incidental (alam avāntareṇa). In-every-way (sarvathā), the-listener-position
(śrotṛpadam), [is]-the-obtained-meaning (upannārtham-eva). By-the-"and-the-rest (ādi)"-grasp,
the-hearing (śravaṇa) [is]-to-be-understood (mantavyam).

Thus, having-established-the-unprecedented-homage-form (apūrvāṃ praṇāmabhaṅgīṃ samarthya),
[and]-having-made-the-reading-of-that-word-with-purpose (tadvākyapāṭhaṃ ca saprayojanīkṛtya),
the-"in-some-way (kathaṃcit)"-sūtra, [which-is]-to-be-explained-by-the-vṛtti — "from-the-Lord's-
favor-alone (parameśvara-prasādād eva)" — [this-vṛtti], to-explain, [he]-says "if-this (yac cedam)."
The-"and (ca)"-word, the-other-object-to-be-explained (prameyāntaram), [is]-joined (samuccinoti).

"By-the-devotion (bhaktyā)" — for, from-the-force-of-the-entry-into-that-own-form
(tatsvarūpa-samāveśa-balād), in-that-real-own-form-Lord (paramārthataḥ svasvarūpe bhagavati),
[and]-manifesting (prakāśamāne), [and]-from-the-arising-of-the-cognition-of-the-falsehood-of-the-
unreal-pride (bhrāntāpāramārthika-abhimāna-tucchatā-vedana-udayāt), in-that-truth-alone, [and]-in-
the-full-bliss-form (pūrṇānanda-rūpe), the-prevalence-of-the-always-entry (satata-samāveśa-
prābalyaṃ), [being]-characterized-by-the-knowledge (vidyālakṣaṇaṃ) — [this]-is-the-devotion
(bhaktiḥ); by-it (tayā). By-the-wishing-of-the-infinite-result (ananta-phalārthitvena), [and]-
the-characterized-by-the-liberation (mokṣa-lakṣaṇaḥ), that-which-is-the-taste (āsvādaḥ), [being]-
full (paripūrṇo), [and]-of-the-all-form-ness (viśvarūpatā-mayaḥ), [and]-of-the-seeing-action-form
(dṛkkriyātmā), [and]-the-reflexion (vimarśaḥ) — he-alone-[is]-the-subject-here (prakṛto yatra).
By-this — "the-Kāṇāda-said (kāṇādokto), the-inert-self (jāḍyātmā) [is]-not-the-liberation
(na mokṣaḥ)" — [he]-says. "And-of-the-liberation, that-which-is-the-taste (mokṣasya ca ya
āsvādaḥ), being-such (evaṃbhūto'sāv), [is]-by-the-part (ityaṃśena), the-reflexion (vimarśaḥ)."
For, by-the-devotion, [which-is]-of-the-form-of-the-entry-into-the-subjection-to-that-supreme-Lord
(tatparameśvara-viṣaya-vaivaśya-samāveśa-rūpayā), that-which-is-the-self's-manifestation
(svātmaprakāśaḥ), he-alone, [being]-not-conjectured-of-the-again-arising (anāśaṅkyamāna-punar-
vyutthānatayā), [is]-the-liberation (mokṣaḥ).

## The dharma / māyā / grace analysis

"Of-the-dharma (dharmasya)" — the-affection-named (praṇayā-paranāma), that-is (iti yāvat).
"Into-the-māyā (māyāntaram), in-the-māyā's-middle (māyāmadhyaṃ), he-causes-to-wander (cārayati
bhramayati); and-in-the-māyā (māyāntare ca), he-wanders (carati)." For-the-māyā-truth
(māyātattvaṃ), of-the-dharma-and-the-rest, [is]-the-abode (āyatanam); the-intellect-truth
(buddhitattvaṃ), [however], [is]-the-station-of-the-vibhava (vibhavasthānam) — this [is]-to-be-
decided (nirṇeṣyate). Here, the-cause (hetuḥ): "raised-up-by-the-restraint-power (niyatiśaktyā
utthāpitam)."

"From-the-performed-horse-sacrifice (aśvamedhāt kṛtāt), that-which-is-the-abiding-place
(adhivāsaḥ), in-the-contracted-consciousness-truth (saṃkucite saṃvittattve), he, in-that-
contraction-part, in-the-māyā-self (saṃkocabhāge māyātmani), [is]-placed (niviṣṭaḥ)" — [this]-is-
fit (yuktam); "not-in-the-consciousness-part (saṃvidbhāge), in-the-removal-of-the-contraction
(saṃkocāpagame), [and]-there-its-non-being (tatra tadabhāvāt)." And-he-alone, [being]-fit-for-
the-ascertainment-in-the-intellect (buddhāvadhyavasāya-yogyatayā), [and]-being-of-the-unfolding-
own-form (vikasvara-svarūpaḥ), [is]-for-the-result (phalāya). "Of-that-dharma (tasya dharmasya),
[being]-gone-to-the-māyā-and-the-intellect (māyābuddhigatasya), the-restraint-truth
(niyatitattvaṃ), [being]-the-regulating (niyāmikā), [and]-the-Lord's-power (pārameśvarī śaktiḥ),
[and]-of-the-essence-of-the-spreading-of-the-śruti-and-the-rest-śāstra (śrūtyādiśāstraprasara-
mayī), [is]-the-occasion (nimittam)."

This-is-said — "of-the-liberation-taste-form (mokṣāsvādasavidhasya), [and]-of-the-devotion's-
subjection-entry (parameśvarabhaktivaivaśya-samāveśasya), the-transcending-the-māyā
(māyottīrṇatvaṃ), [is]-the-pervader (vyāpakaṃ); and-the-opposed-to-that (tadviruddhaṃ), the-
being-inside-the-māyā (māyāntarvartitvam). Of-it, the-cause (tasya kāraṇaṃ), the-dharma (dharmaḥ)
— how (katham), [being]-pervaded-by-the-opposed-to-its-own-effect (svakāryaviruddhavyāptaṃ),
[and]-toward-the-prostrate (prahvaṃ), [would]-go-to-the-cause-ness (hetutāṃ gacchet)?" Thus-this-
is-the-inference (prayogaḥ): "the-devotion's-subjection [is]-not-the-dharma's-result
(na bhaktivaivaśyaṃ dharmaphalaṃ), from-the-perception-of-the-liberation-taste-form-ness
(mokṣāsvādamayatvopalambhāt); [and]-the-māyā-inside-ness, [which]-is-the-pervader-of-the-dharma-
result-ness (dharmaphalatvavyāpaka-māyāntarvartitvam), [being]-opposed, [and]-of-the-
transcending-the-māyā, [which]-is-the-pervaded-of-the-liberation-taste-form-ness (māyottīrṇatā-
vyāptasya mokṣāsvādamayatvasya), the-perception (upalabdhiḥ), [and]-of-the-dharma-result-ness,
[which]-is-pervaded-by-the-opposed-to-its-own-pervader (svavyāpaka-viruddhavyāptasya
dharmaphalatvasya), does-the-negation (niṣedham karoti)."

## The grace (prasāda) and the māyā

"The-unbridled (viśṛṅkhalaḥ), [and]-the-not-expecting-the-self-rule-conceived-dharma-and-the-rest
(svaniyatikalpitadharmādy-anapekṣo), [and]-of-the-Lord (īśvarasya), the-favor (prasādaḥ),
[being]-of-the-form-of-the-removal-of-the-impurity-conceived-by-the-own-freedom, [and]-whose-
nature-is-the-covering-of-the-māyā-veil (māyāpaṭa-pracchannatātmaka-svasvātantrya-upakalpita-
kāluṣyāpasāraṇena), [and]-of-the-essence-of-the-own-nature-manifesting-nir-malatva
(svasvabhāvaprakaṭanātmaka-nairmalyamayaḥ), [and] — 'I (yo'ham), [being]-concealed (pracchannaḥ)
by-the-form-of-this-knower (etatpramātṛrūpatayā), by-the-own-form-alone (svasvarūpeṇaiva), in-the-
manifestation (prakāśe), [and]-I-reflect (vimṛśāmi ca)' — [this]-being-such-form (evaṃrūpaḥ); that-
fitness (tadyogyatā-ātmā), by-the-particular-manner (prakāra-viśeṣeṇa), not-by-the-other-worldly-
manner (na anyena laukikena prakāreṇa), the-becoming (bhavanam) of-him [is]-to-be-conjectured
(saṃbhāvyam)."

"In-every-way (sarvathā), the-nir-malatva-self (nairmalyātmā), the-favor (prasādaḥ), [is]-the-
Lord-form-ness (bhagavadrūpatā); the-identity (tādātmyaṃ), [is]-the-liberation-alone (mokṣa eva).
There (tatra), [there-is]-not-the-māyā-impression (na māyāsaṃskāraḥ); here (iha), [however], that-
too (so'pi), by-his-will-alone (tadicchayaiva), [and]-being-the-executor-of-the-help-to-the-
worlds' duty (lokānugraha-kṛtya-nirvāhaṇakāriṇyā), [is] (astīti)."

"By-the-form-of-the-fitness (pātratārūpeṇa)" — the-not-world-famous-particular-manner
(lokāprasiddha-prakāra-viśeṣaṇam) [is]-taken-up (upāttam). "For-the-māyā-made (māyīyo hi), the-
cause-effect-relation (kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ), [and]-by-the-dream-potter's-pot-maxim
(svapnagatakulālaghaṭanyāyena), [and]-resting-in-the-own-freedom-essence-such-manifestation-form-
consciousness-established-supreme-agent-ness (svātantryasāra-tathābhāsana-rūpa-saṃvinniṣṭha-
pāramārthika-kartṛtvātmaka-kāryakāraṇabhāva-bhittiviśrānto), in-the-māyā-made-world (māyāmaye
loke), [and]-being-heart-reaching (hṛdayaṃgamatvāt), [is]-well-known (prasiddhaḥ). But-where-it-
is-not-possible (satu yatra nopapadyate), there-it, [being]-the-supreme-real (pāramārthikaḥ eva)
— that-which-was-explained (yad vyākhyātaṃ), this-this-thing (tat tad vastu) — [by]-this-refutation
(anena khaṇḍanena), the-vṛtti-kāra-says (brūte); everywhere, [this-is]-the-vivṛti-kāra's-style
(sarvatra vivṛtikārasya śailī).

"In-the-merit-demerit-and-the-rest-result (dharmādharmādiphale'pi), in-the-thing (vastuni), [is]-
the-use-of-the-Lord's-favor, [which-is]-connected-with-the-merit-and-the-rest-governing-
intellect-establishment (dharmādyadhiṣṭhātṛbuddhimadadhiṣṭhāna-nāntarīyaka-parameśvara-prasādo-
payogaḥ)" — [with]-this-suspicion (āśaṅkya), the-"only (eva)"-word, in-the-vṛtti, [and]-explained-
by-the-"unbridled (viśṛṅkhala)"-word.

## The grammar of "kathaṃcit" (the manner)

"By-some-manner (kenacit prakāreṇa)" — how, [with]-the-fifth-[case] (pañcamyā), the-explanation
[is]-to-be-made — [with]-this-suspicion (āśaṅkya), in-three-ways (tridhā), he-establishes
(samarthayate). "To-the-those-speaking-the-manner-distinguished-meaning (prakāratvaviśiṣṭārtha-
abhidhāyibhyaḥ), [and]-to-the-what-and-the-rest (kimādibhyaḥ), the-'tham'-suffix (thamu-pratyayaḥ)
[is]-prescribed, [in]-the-own-meaning (svārthe): 'what-manner (kaḥ prakāraḥ)? how (katham)?' But-
of-it, with-the-expectation-of-the-external-relation (bāhyasaṃbandhy-apekṣayā), the-fit-case-
meaning (ucita-vibhakty-arthaḥ) [is]-conceived (kalpyate). And-here (iha), from-the-occasion-of-
the-cause-form-ness (heturūpatā-prastāvāt), the-fifth-meaning-alone (pañcamyartha eva) [is]-fit
(ucitaḥ), not-the-third-meaning (na tṛtīyārthaḥ); [and]-by-the-rule (niyamena), [he]-has-entered
(anupraviṣṭo'tra) — [this]-is-one-manner (ekaḥ prakāraḥ)."

"Or (atha), as — 'of-the-being-words (bhāvavacanānām)' — here, 'of-the-being-agent (bhāvakartṛkāṇām)'
— this-meaning [is], [and]-in-the-'word'-word (vacanāśabde), [being]-agent-made (kartṛsādhane),
[and]-of-the-meaning-part-of-the-base (prakṛtyarthāṃśasya), [and]-of-the-mere-means (upāyamātrasya),
[from]-the-not-wishing-to-speak (avivakṣaṇāt); thus, in-'the-manner-word (prakāravacana)',
[and]-in-the-'word'-word, [being]-instrument-made (karaṇasādhane), [and]-of-the-base (prakṛteḥ),
[which-is]-distinguished-by-the-instrument-form-attained-manner-meaning (karaṇarūpatāpanna-
prakārārtha-viśiṣṭāyāḥ), [is]-the-'tham' (thamuḥ). And-thus, in-the-third-ending (tṛtīyānte), the-
not-world-famous-compound (naiva prasiddho vigrahaḥ)."

"Even-so (evam api), the-cause (hetuḥ)-alone, in-the-sūtra, [is]-intended-to-be-said-as-the-cause
(kāraṇatvena vivakṣita) — to-make-known (pratipādayituṃ), in-the-vṛtti, [and]-the-not-doubted-
cause-ness (asandigdhām), to-speak (abhidhātuṃ), the-fifth (pañcamī) [is]-used (prayuktā) — [this]-
is-the-second-explanation (dvitīyā vyākhyā). In-both-these-explanations (anayor dvayor api), the-
cause-particular-alone (hetuviśeṣa eva), the-cause-manner (hetuprakāraḥ), [is]-said."

"Or-even-so (athāpi evaṃ syāt): 'the-manner (prakāraḥ)' — the-excellent-action (prakṛṣṭā kriyā),
the-distinguished-action-difference (viśiṣṭaḥ kriyābhedaḥ), [is]-said (ucyate). And-hence, thus —
that-by-which, by-the-mere-difference-of-the-substance, the-quality-and-the-rest
(dravyaguṇādibhedamātreṇa), the-'tham' [is]-used; the-word (śabdaḥ) — then, 'what-quality, what-
substance, what-action' (kiṃ guṇo dravyaṃ karma vā) — in-this-matter, since-the-'what'
(kathaṃśabdaḥ) [is]-not-used (prayogābhāvāt), then-the-cause-manner (hetuprakāraḥ), by-the-'how'
-word, [is]-not-said; but-the-action-manner-alone (kriyāprakāra eva). And-the-action, here, [is]-
the-obtaining-action (āsādanakriyā); of-it, the-manner [is]-the-cause-difference-made (hetubhedakṛta
eva). 'The-obtaining-of-the-Lord's-service (parameśvaradāsyāsādanaṃ)' — that-[is]-one, [with]-
the-distress, the-desire-to-know, the-wishing-of-the-result, the-eagerness-and-the-rest-causes
(ārtijijñāsāphalautsukyādi-nimittam); [and]-this, [however], [is]-another-alone (anya eva) — the-
obtaining-difference (āsādanabhedaḥ). Thus-the-'in-some-way'-word (kathaṃciditiśabdaḥ), [and]-
being-joined-with-the-'having-obtained'-word (āsādyaśabdena saha militaḥ), [is]-to-be-explained
(vyākhyātavyaḥ)."

"The-cause-by-the-māheśvara-favor (maheśvaraprasādahetuka), this-obtaining-difference
(āsādanabhedo'yaṃ), [and]-being-the-prior-being (pūrvabhāvī), in-the-vṛtti, [is]-explained, [and]-
by-the-'obtained'-word (labdhaśabdena), [being]-the-kta-ending (ktāntena), [and]-of-the-past-ness
(paurvakālikatvasya) [by]-the-explanation, [and]-by-the-compound (samāsena ca), [and]-by-the-making-
the-agent's-body-entry (kartṛśarīrānupraveśakāriṇā), [and]-by-the-agent's-door (kartṛdvāreṇa),
[and]-of-the-sentence-meaning-animation (vākyārthānuprāṇakatvāt)."

"The-making-clear (sphuṭīkaraṇam), of-the-same-agent-ness (samānakartṛkatvasya), [and]-of-the-
root-meaning-connection (dhātvartha-saṃbandhasya), by-the-obtaining-difference
(āsādanabhedena); [and] — 'having-obtained (āsādya)' — by-the-universal-particular-ness
(sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena), the-action-instrument-relation (kriyākaraṇabhāvaḥ), [is]-the-marked-
marking-relation (upalakṣyopalakṣaṇabhāvo vā)." "Of-that-alone (tasyaiva)" — by-the-"only (eva)"
-word, the-not-expecting-the-other (anyānapekṣā) [is]-said. "By-which (yayā)..." — by-the-door-of-
the-result-determination (phala-nirūpaṇa-dvāreṇa), the-non-being-of-the-result-intention
(phalābhisandhānābhāvaḥ) [is]-said.

## The devotion (bhakti) and the śraddhā

"That-being (tadbhāvaṃ), by-the-obtaining-of-that-taste (tadāsvāda-lābhena), [and]-the-entry-
subjection-gone (tadāveśa-vaivaśyaṃ gatam), [is]-the-mental (mānasam) — of-these (eṣām)" — [this]-
[is]-the-devotion's-own-form (bhakteḥ svarūpam), [is]-said. "But-of-him-not-having-obtained-that-
taste (alabdha-tadāsvādasya-api), there (tatra), the-attainment-grasp (prāptigrahaḥ), [is]-the-
faith (śraddhā)." Thus-they-say:

> "The-faith-result (śraddhāphalaṃ), the-devotion [is]-said (bhaktir uktā); without-it (tadvinā),
> not-even-the-existence (nāsituṃ ghaṭaḥ) [is]-possible."

## The good-person and the eligibility

Then, "wishing-the-help-of-the-people, too (janasyāpy upakāramicchan)" — this-sūtra-part, [and]-
the-vṛtti — "being-ashamed-of-the-alone-prosperity (ahamekākisaṃpadā lajjamānaḥ)" — [this-vṛtti],
to-explain, he-begins: "and-by-the-good-person (sajjanena ca)." The-"and (ca)"-word, making-the-
joining-of-the-other-object-to-be-explained (prameyāntarasamuccayaṃ kurvan), [and]-like-before
(pūrvavat), [is]-the-manifestor-of-the-beginning-of-the-other-to-be-explained
(vyākhyeyāntaropakramadyotakaḥ). "From-the-obtaining-of-the-Lord's-service-alone
(īśvaradāsyāsādanād eva), the-fullness-self (pūrṇatātmakaḥ), the-good-person-being
(sajjanabhāvaḥ). For-the-not-full-alone (apūrṇa eva hi), [thinking]-'I-would-fill-myself-from-all-
sides (svātmānaṃ sarvataḥ pūrayiṣyāmi)', [does]-the-great-harming (paramapakaroti), [and]-not-the-
helping (nopakaroti vā); hence-the-bad-person (tato durjanaḥ). Hence, indeed — 'to-be (bhāvyam)',
[is]-in-the-not-necessary-'ṇyat' (avāśyake ṇyat). By-that-self-full-one (ātmambhariṇā tena),
[it-is]-not-to-be (avaśyaṃ na bhūyate) — 'I (aham)' — [this-is]-the-fullness-support-reflection
(pūrṇatvāvaṣṭambha-parāmarśaḥ)."

"Not-I, [and]-not-having-obtained-the-hard-to-get-that-service, [am]-alone (nau labdha-
durlabhataddāsyo'hamekākibhattyeti), [is]-to-be-said — what, by-the-'prosperity'-and-the-'assets'-
words (kiṃ lakṣmīsaṃpacchabdābhyām)?" "The-all (samastā)," [and]-of-the-sūtra's-qualifier-of-the-
recognition (sautrasya pratyabhijñāviśeṣaṇasya), the-being-the-qualifier-of-the-service
(dāsyaviśeṣaṇatā), [and]-the-indicating (apiśunasūcanam), not-by-another-effort (na
prayāsāntareṇa) — [with]-this-suspicion, [he]-says "the-assets (saṃpat)." "The-lordship-made
(aiśvaryamayī), [and]-of-the-form-of-the-entry-into-the-Maheśvara (maheśvarasamāveśa-rūpā), [and]-
which-is-the-pre-eminent-devotion (prakṛṣṭā bhaktiḥ), [and]-being-partaker-of-the-fruit-and-the-
limb (phalāṅgibhāvabhāgibhavān), [and]-distinguished-from-the-other-Lord's-favorite-devotions
(vallabhabhaktyantaravilakṣaṇā), [and]-intended (vivakṣitā) — she, by-the-'lakṣmī'-word, [and]-by-
the-'assets'-word (saṃpatpadena), [and]-by-the-indicating-of-the-'all'-qualifier-of-the-service
(samastetyasya dāsyaviśeṣaṇatāsūcanena), [is]-pointed-out (nirdiṣṭā)."

"The-'assets'-word (saṃpatpadaṃ), [being]-near-to-the-to-be-explained (vyākhyeyapratyāsatteḥ),
[is]-taken-up-first (pūrvam upāttam); [and]-from-that-occasion (tatprasaṅgāt), [and]-last
(caramaṃ), the-'lakṣmī'-word."

**Objection (nanu):** "The-pre-eminent-devotion (prakṛṣṭā bhaktiḥ), [being]-barren-of-the-result-
intention (phalābhisandhi-vandhyā), how (katham), the-'all'-qualifier (samasteti-viśeṣaṇaṃ), [being]-
contradicted (viruddham), does-it-bear (sahate)?" — to-this-suspicion, [he]-says "because (yataḥ)."
"The-all-ness (samastatvam), [is]-the-unlimited-ness (anavacchinnatvaṃ) of-the-assets
(saṃpadām). And-that (tacca), by-the-force-of-the-entry-into-the-Lord (parameśvarāveśavaśād eva) —
here [there-is]-no-contradiction (na atra virodhaḥ). Since-thus-formed (yata evaṃbhūtā), [and]-
the-Lord-attainment-form (parameśvarāpattirūpā), the-pre-eminent-devotion (bhaktiḥ prakṛṣṭā),
[is] — hence, indeed (tata eva), the-many-meaning-functioning (bahvarthavṛttir), the-'lakṣmī'-word
(lakṣmīśabdaḥ)" — [this-is]-the-relation-by-distance (dūreṇa saṃbandhaḥ). In-the-middle, though
(madhye tu atra), [is]-the-asserting-book (saṃvādako granthaḥ), [and]-that-joining (tadyojanaṃ ca)
— [it-is]-sung-by-the-guru, toward-Arjuna (gītam iti guruṇā arjunaṃ prati):

> "In-four-ways (caturvidhā), the-merit-possessors (sukṛtinaḥ), the-people (janāḥ), serve-me
> (bhajante māṃ), always (sadā): the-distressed (ārto), the-desire-to-know (jijñāsur), the-wealth-
> seeking (arthārthī), and-the-wise (jñānī)..." — (Bhagavadgītā 7.16)

— [the-four bhaktas]. By-the-certainty-of-the-being-the-cause-of-the-removal-of-the-suffering
(duḥkhanirākaraṇakāraṇatā-niścayena vā), or-by-the-certainty-of-the-being-the-cause-of-the-
attainment-of-the-happiness (sukhasaṃpattihetutā-niścayena vā) [they approach]...

---

## T1 apparatus — the key decisions (Chunk B)

1. **the prostration's two faces** — the homage both lowers oneself AND exalts the Lord; the
   word "namas" carries both (the excellence is the rest-in-the-Lord).
2. **the disciple's eligibility** — the listener, in hearing, reflects "I am the recipient of the
   secret-teaching; the recognition is established by the exegete; I make the operator's activity."
   The eligibility-ladder (the "go" example): the not-eligible rests on the first stair.
3. **the four bhaktas (Gītā 7.16)** — the distressed, the desire-to-know, the wealth-seeker, the
   wise — Abhinava's framework for the approaches to the Lord.
4. **the dharma/mokṣa distinction** — the dharma (merit) is māyā-made, inside the māyā; the
   liberation-taste (mokṣāsvāda) transcends the māyā. The devotion's subjection is not the
   dharma's result.
5. **māyā / niyati / prasāda** — the restraint-power (niyati) governs the dharma in the māyā;
   the Lord's grace (prasāda) is the unbridled, nir-mala (stainless) favor that transcends the
   māyā.
6. **śraddhā / bhakti** — the faith (the attainment-grasp without the taste) vs the devotion
   (the actual entry-taste). "The faith-result is the devotion."
7. **the grammar of "kathaṃcit āsādya"** — the manner (prakāra), the fifth-case (the cause), the
   causatives (ṇij) — Abhinava's grammatical precision about how the "in-some-way" obtains the
   Lord's service.
8. **kathaṃcit = "in some way"** — the sūtra's opening word, glossed through the whole
   eligibility/disciple/guru analysis.

**The crux:** the eligibility for the recognition. The whole of kārikā 1.1's commentary on
"kathaṃcit āsādya" (having obtained in some way) unfolds into: the prostration's two faces, the
disciple's/teacher's roles, the four bhaktas, the dharma-vs-mokṣa distinction, the grace, and
the grammar of the manner. This establishes the work's whole frame — who is qualified, how the
Lord is approached, and what the recognition is.


---

# IPVV Vol 1 — Chunk C: the svātmā, the māyā, the Upaniṣadic citations, the jñātṛ-kartṛ — T1

*Source: M00020 lines 1200–1800 (continuous). Base: Torella's ĪPK 1.1 (the commentary on
"svātmā"/the self-as-Lord continues). Covers: the analysis of "own-self" (svātmā), the māyā,
the Upaniṣadic assertions ("sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma," "neha nānāsti kiṃcana"), the Gītā 7.12,
the prakāśa/vimarśa, the knower-agent (jñātṛ-kartṛ) identity, and the grammar of the
seventh/sixth cases. Max-effort T1.*

---

## The svātmā (the own-self) and the relation

[He] draws-in-the-relation (saṃbandhinam ākarṣati); that [relation], [being]-determinate
(niyataḥ), is-not, first, [and]-from-the-not-being-said (anuktatvāt), [and]-from-the-not-
attaining-the-context (aprakaraṇāpannatvāt) — [so]-all-is-perceived (sarva eva pratīyate). "From-
the-not-taking-up (anupādānāt)" — by-the-word, or-by-the-context (śabdena prakaraṇena vā). "From-
the-all-inclusion (sarvāntarbhāvāt)" — [this-is]-the-objection (codyam). "If-that (yadyasau)" —
[this-is]-the-established-view (siddhāntaḥ).

There, in-the-objection (codye), first, this-is-the-intention (āśayaḥ): "From-the-not-determinate-
ness (aniyatatvāt) of-the-relation (saṃbandhino), the-whole (nikhila eva) — [and]-the-inert-and-
the-non-inert (jaḍaś ca ajaḍaś ca) — the-being-class (bhāvavargaḥ), [is]-perceived (pratīyate).
There, of-the-non-inert (ajaḍānāṃ), he-the-self (sa ātmā), [being]-of-the-consciousness-mark
(caitanya-lakṣaṇaḥ), [and]-one (ekaḥ), sometimes (kadācit), [is]-able-to-be-said (śakyo'bhidhātum);
but-the-inert (jaḍāḥ), [being]-these, [and]-of-the-separate-cut-off-own-forms
(pṛthakparicchinnasvarūpāḥ), how (katham), [being]-of-the-one-self (ekātmānaḥ)? — from-the-
contradiction-of-the-one-own-form-ness-of-the-different-own-natures (pṛthaksvabhāvānām
ekasvabhāvatvavirodhād)."

Of-the-reply (uttarasya), however, this-is-the-intention (ayam āśayaḥ): "Here, 'own-self (svātmā)'
— the-'own' (sva), [being]-the-other-expecting (anyāpekṣasya), [and]-the-self's-own-general-mark
(sva-sāmānyalakṣaṇa), [and]-the-artha-kriyā-agent-ness-and-the-rest (arthakriyākāritvāder) [is]-
the-relation (saṃbandhī), [and]-the-own (ātmīyo), [and]-the-not-expecting-the-other
(ananyāpekṣo), [and]-the-not-conditioned (anaupādhiko), [he]-becomes (bhavati)."

There — those-inert-ones (ye jaḍāḥ), [being]-perceived-as-inert (jaḍābhimatāḥ), [then]-their-
being-and-non-being (sadasattvam api) [is]-hard-to-get-in-the-self (durlabham ātmani); what-then
(kā tu kathā), of-the-blue-yellow-pleasure-pain-ness-and-the-rest (nīlapītasukhaduḥkhāditvasya)?
For — "that-which, in-the-own-self, exists (yaḥ svātmani san), if-it-were-non-existent (yadi
asan syāt), what-would-be-its-fault (kim asya duṣyet)?" — so, "it-would-do-the-artha-kriyā
(tathaiva arthakriyāṃ kuryād)" — if-it-is-so (iti cet), "it-does (karoti)" — if-this-were
(evaṃ yadi syāt), then-what-would-be (tat kiṃ syāt)? — so, "it-would-shine-thus (tathaiva
prakāśeteti)" — if-it-is-so (cet), "the-manifest-ness, [being]-its-own-glory (prakāśamānatā
kim asya svamahimā)"? "Om (om)" — if-it-is-so (iti cet): "to-me-it-shines, to-Caitra-it-shines
(mama prakāśate, caitrasya prakāśate)" — how-do-they-concur (kathaṃ saṃgacchatām)? "The-cognition-
[is]-that-manifest-ness (prātipattrī sā prakāśateti)" — if-it-is-so (cet), "of-the-cognition,
if-that [is], then-of-it, what-may-it-be (pratipattur yadyasau, tat tasya sā kiṃ bhavatu)?" "By-
its-force-it-shines (tadvaśāt sa prakāśata)" — this-[is]-an-unprecedented-reason (apūrvā yuktiḥ)!
For-thus, "by-the-white's-force, the-yellow-would-be-white (śvetavaśāt pītaṃ śvetate)" — this,
too, [would]-follow (syāt).

"If-of-this, [being]-own (asya ātmīyaṃ), by-its-force, elsewhere-it-does-not-become (tadvaśād
anyatra na bhavati), like-the-blue-in-the-yellow (nīlateva pīte); and-thus, the-manifest-form-ness
(prakāśarūpatā), [being]-the-knower's-own (pramātur ātmīyā), how, in-the-blue, would-it-be (kathaṃ
sā nīle bhavet)?" There, "of-the-becoming-in-that, the-identity (tatra bhavanasya tādātmyaṃ), [is]-
the-pervader (vyāpakaṃ); otherwise, in-the-blue-too, 'the-yellow' (nīle'pi pītatā) — and-the-rest,
[being]-a-thousand-branch (sahasraśākham), [and]-the-incoherence (āsamañjasyam): the-seen-
silver-ness-(dṛśyamānatādrūpya) [and]-the-rule's-opposed (vyāpakasya niyamasya viruddhaṃ) — [it]-
would-be-joined (prasajyeta)."

"Of-that-identity, the-other-self-ness (tasya tādātmyasya viruddham anyātmatvaṃ), [and]-that, [is]-
the-other-owned-ness (tadeva ca anyadīyatvam); or-else, of-the-other, that-relation — how (athā
anyasya tatsaṃbandhīti katham)?"

## The blue and the consciousness

"And-this — of-the-blue-and-the-rest, without-the-manifest-ness (nīlādeḥ prakāśamānatvam vinā),
[there-is]-not-any-own-life (na kiñcit nijajīvitam) — [and]-the-not-to-be-denied
(anapahnavanīya-prakāśamānatā-bala), [and]-the-knower-manifestation-identity (pramātṛprakāśatā-
tādātmyaṃ), [is]-to-be-accepted (aṅgīkāryam). Thus-the-blue-and-the-rest, too (bodhātmāna eva
nīlādayo'pi), [are]-of-the-awareness-essence (bodha-ātmānaḥ); not-their-other-body (na eṣāmanyat
vapuḥ) — so, of-them, too, that-alone-[is]-the-own-self (teṣām api sa eva svātmā), [i.e.] the-
Lord (maheśvaraḥ) — [this]-is-the-desired (iṣṭam eva)."

"What-[is]-the-import (kaḥ prasaṅgārthaḥ)?" "The-attainment-of-the-undesired (aniṣṭāpattiḥ), [is]-
the-import (prasaṅgaḥ)." This-he-says: "let-the-clod-and-the-rest-be (āstāṃ loṣṭādiḥ)." For, of-
it, [being]-clearly-manifesting (sphuṭaṃ prakāśamānasya), in-the-awareness-essence-ness
(bodhātmatāyāṃ), what-[is]-the-dispute (ko vivādaḥ)? "The-non-being (abhāvo'pi), too, which-
[is]-agreed-by-someone-as-'the-empty, [and]-nothing (yastuccho na kiñcidity evaṃ kasyāpi
saṃmataḥ), that-too, [being]-thus (so'pi yāvad evam), [and]-not-shining (na cakāsti) — so-long,
[and]-being-other-than-the-being (tāvad bhāvād anyat sa iti), this-alone — whence (etadeva kuto
bhavet)?" "If-[it]-is-being-cognized (budhyamānaś cet), then-of-it, too, [is]-the-Lord-alone-the-
own-self (tad asyāpi maheśvara eva svātmā)." "But-if-[it]-is-the-not-cognized-non-being (atha
abudhyamāno'sāv abhāvaḥ), then-he-[is]-not-anyone (na kaścidasāv); of-whom, [then], [and]-then
(kasya asau tadānīṃ) — the-own-self-[is]-joined (svātmā prasajyate)?" Thus, of-the-not-cognized-
blue-and-the-rest, too (evaṃ nīlāder-api abudhyamānasya), who-[is]-the-own-self (kaḥ svātmeti) —
the-"being-cognized"-word (budhyamānapadam). This-is-said: "when-the-objection-[is]-made (yadā
codyaṃ kriyate), 'of-the-blue-and-its-non-being-and-the-rest, too, the-own-self-the-Lord-[is]-
joined (nīlatadabhāvāder-api svātmā maheśvaraḥ prasajyate)', [then], the-acceptance-of-the-being-
cognized-ness-alone (budhyamānatvasya aṅgīkāra eva), [is]-the-reply (uttaram); otherwise, [the]-
not-having-the-support (nirāśrayaṃ) [is]-the-objection (codyam)."

## The division (vibhāga) and the body

**Objection (nanu):** "Thus — if-the-Lord (maheśvaraś cet), [is]-the-blue's-self (nīlasya ātmā),
[and]-of-the-yellow, too, he-alone (pītasyāpi sa eva) — [then] 'this-is-the-blue, this-is-the-
yellow (nīlam idaṃ, pītam idam)' — whence-the-division (kuto vibhāga)?" — [he]-says "all-indeed
(sarvam eva)." Because, of-the-consciousness-form-self (cidrūpasya ātmanaḥ), [and]-of-the-
manifestation-form-own-nature (prakāśarūpasya svasvabhāvasya), the-whole-known (sarvam eva
vedyam), like-the-body (śarīram-iva) — as-the-body, though-known (vedyam-api), [and]-by-the-
support-of-the-"I" (ahamity avaṣṭambhāt), [and]-the-un-metaphorical (anupacaritāt), [is]-joined-
with-the-consciousness-form (cidrūpānuviddhaṃ); so, too, the-whole (tathaiva viśvam). For-not-
like-the-blanket-and-the-rest (nahi kambalādivat), in-the-body (dehe), [and]-from-the-instrument-
ness (upakaraṇatvād), the-metaphorical-ness (upacaritātā), [and]-of-the-"I"-being (ahaṃbhāvasya),
in-the-world (loke), [and]-even-of-the-those-thinking-themselves-separate (pṛthagātmamāninām-api),
[is]-seen (bhāsate).

Thus, [and]-from-the-consciousness-form-entry (cidrūpatānuvedhāt), as-the-cognition (saṃvit), [by]-
the-will-be-said-maxim (vakṣyamāṇanayena), [is]-of-the-all-form (viśvarūpā); so, too, the-blue-
yellow-being-array-and-the-rest (nīlapītādibhāvāvalī api) — hence-the-not-wished (anabhimata eva)
[is]-our-division (asmākaṃ vibhāgaḥ).

## The Upaniṣadic assertion (the Vedānta cross-check)

This, with-the-Vedāntin's-book-word (vedāntavādi-granthavacasā), he-brings-to-agreement
(saṃvādayati) — "the-portion, too (pradeśo'pi)." As — "the-pot-space, the-cloth-space
(ghaṭākāśaṃ paṭākāśam)" — of-the-space (ākāśasya), [and]-by-the-pot-and-the-rest-connection
(ghaṭādiyogena), the-portions (pradeśāḥ) [are]-conceived (kalpitāḥ); [and]-of-the-space, whatever-
[is]-the-form (yāvad rūpaṃ), the-omnipresence-and-the-rest (vibhutvādi), by-it, [they are]-not-
less-or-more (tena anūnādhikāḥ); so — of-the-Brahman (brahmaṇaḥ), [being]-great (vṛhattvena),
[and]-pervading (vyāpakasya), [and]-making-grow (vṛṃhakatvena), [and]-the-executor-of-the-world's-
creation-and-nourishment (viśvasṛṣṭyāpyāyanavidhāyinaḥ), [and]-of-the-manifestation-form
(prakāśarūpasya), [and]-by-the-own-power-reflected-blue-and-the-rest-conditions
(svaśaktipratyavabhāsita-nīlādyupādhikṛtāḥ), those-portions (ye pradeśāḥ) — "the-blue-
manifestation, the-yellow-manifestation (nīlaprakāśaḥ pītaprakāśaḥ)" — [and]-the-rest (ityādayaḥ);
they (te), in-the-Brahman (brahmaṇi), that-which-is-the-all-form-ness (sarvārūpyaṃ), [and]-the-all-
power-undivided-functioning-ness (sarvaśaktyavibhāgavṛttitvaṃ), [and]-the-which (yacca), [by]-the-
mere-manifest-ness-form (prakāśamānatā-mātra-rūpeṇa), [and]-the-counterpart-deficiency
(pratiyogivaikalya), [and]-in-the-absence-of-the-to-be-removed (apohanīyābhāve), [and]-from-the-
non-possibility-of-the-constructive-form-ness (vikalparūpatvāyogād), [and]-the-counterpart-less-
sensation-form (apratiyogisaṃvedana-rūpam), [and]-the-non-constructive-ness (avikalpatvam) — that
(tat), individually (pratyekam), [they]-do-not-exceed (anatikrāntāḥ); hence (tataḥ), [and]-not-in-
the-least (manāg-api), [and]-the-not-more (anadhikāś ca).

"The-two (dvayam), mutually (anyonyam), the-reason-and-what-has-the-reason-relation
(hetuhetumadbhāvaṃ), [is]-shown (dyotayati)."

**Objection (nanu):** "Thus — let-the-undivided-form-ness (avibhāgarūpatā) be, [being]-arrived-at-
by-reason (yuktyupanipatitā); but-this (yastu ayam), 'the-blue, the-yellow' — in-the-known (vedye),
[and]-'I-am-Caitra, I-am-Maitra' — in-the-knower (vedake), the-division-manifestation
(vibhāgapratibhāsaḥ) — that-how-do-we-establish (tat kathaṃ samarthayāmahe)?" — [he]-says "only
(kevalam), [and]-the-inert (jaḍaḥ)." "Inert (jaḍaḥ)" — [i.e.]-shining-by-the-other-dependent-
manifest-ness (anyādhīnaprakāśatayā bhāsamānaḥ), this-is-the-meaning (ityarthaḥ).

## The will-be-said (the māyā-śakti and the body)

"Will-be-said (vakṣyamāṇā)" —

> "The-to-be-given-up (heyā), [is]-the-threefold (trayī), [and]-of-the-breath-and-the-rest
> (prāṇādeḥ), [from]-the-primacy (prādhānyāt), in-the-agent-ness-quality (kartṛtāguṇe)" — (3.29)

— here, [this]-will-be-said (vakṣyate). "The-Lord's-manifestation-alone (parameśvaraprakāśa eva),
[and]-by-his-own-māyā-power (svamāyāśaktyā), [which-is]-of-the-form-of-the-freedom-of-the-doing-
of-the-exceedingly-difficult (atidurghaṭakāritva-svātantrya-rūpayā), [and]-the-own-form
(svarūpam), [being]-not-covered (anācchāditam-api), [as]-covered (ācchāditam-iva), [he]-manifests
(avabhāsayati)." There — "in-the-primacy-of-the-not-covering-part (anācchādana-aṃśa-pradhānatāyāṃ),
[is]-the-entry-into-the-Sadāśiva-Īśvara-form-state (sadāśiveśvararūpatā-samāveśa-daśā); in-the-
primacy-of-the-covering-part-manifestation (ācchādanabhāgāvabhāsa-pradhānatāyāṃ), [is]-the-
māyā-unfolding-form (māyāvijṛmbhā-rūpā), [and]-the-saṃsāra-state (saṃsāridaśā)."

Hence — "the-'blue'-and-the-rest-known-difference (nīlam ityādi-vedyabhedaḥ), [and]-the-own-body-
difference-manifestation-marked (ābhāsamāna-kāyabhedopalakṣita), [and]-the-intellect, the-breath,
the-body-made-of-the-eight, and-the-rest-condition-difference-mounted (buddhiprāṇapuryaṣṭakādy-
upādhibhedārūṣita), [and]-the-consciousness-shadow-made (caitanyacchāyākṛto), [and]-the-knower-
difference (vedakabheda)" — in-the-division-unfolding (bhedavijṛmbhāyāṃ), the-māyā-knower-ness
(māyāpramātṛtve) [is]-the-body-crowned (kāyo mūrdhābhiṣiktaḥ). And-thus — "from-the-removal-of-
that-alone (taducchedād eva prabhṛti), the-liberation-practical-activity (mokṣavyavahāraḥ), 'there-
there, the-destruction (tatra tatra vaikaraṇyaṃ), the-liberation (mokṣaḥ)' — and-the-rest (ityādau)."
That-primacy-of-it (tatpradhānyam asya), [he]-indicates: "the-body, too (kāyo'pi vā)."

"This (ayam), first (pūrvaṃ), [and]-from-the-manifest-form-ness (prakāśarūpatvāt), [and]-being-of-
the-consciousness-form-alone (cidrūpa eva), [and]-from-the-freedom (svātantryāt), [and]-brought-
to-the-known-ness (vedyatāṃ nītaḥ), like-the-clod-and-the-rest (loṣṭādivad eva), [and]-being-known
(vedya eva san), [and]-from-the-non-self-being (nātmabhāvād), [and]-by-the-removal-alone
(apahastanenaiva), [and]-the-'I'-sensation-identity (aham iti saṃvedana-tādātmyam), [and]-the-
over-lord-ed (adhiśāyitaḥ)."

"In-the-self, plunging (ātmani nimajjya)" — "the-blue-and-the-rest, [being]-in-the-blue-form-ness
(nīlādir nīlarūpatve), plunge-the-manifestation (prakāśaṃ nimajjayati); by-which (yena), by-the-
manifestation-force (prakāśabalāt), 'this-is-the-blue (nīlam idam)' — [this]-manifestation
(prakāśaḥ), [is]-made-limited (parimitībhavati); by-which (yena), [and]-by-the-known-property-ness
(vedyadharmatvena), [and]-manifest (prakaṭo'yam artho dṛṣṭaḥ), [and]-'the-object-to-be-known
(prameyaḥ)' — [thus]-it-shines (bhāti)." "And-in-the-body, [being]-plunged (kāye ca nimagnaḥ),
[and]-'that-I (so'ham)', [is]-the-limited-manifestation (prakāśaḥ parimitaḥ), [and]-by-the-
place-difference (upapattideśabhedena), [and]-by-the-past-and-the-rest-time-calculation
(atītādikālaka-lanayā), [and]-by-the-Rudra-kṣetrajña-and-their-sub-kinds-knower-form
(rudrakṣetrajña-tadavāntaraprakāra-pramātṛ-rūpeṇa), [and]-by-the-own-form-difference
(svarūpabhedena), [and]-by-the-other-place-time-form-separate-ness (anyadeśakālasvarūpaviviktatvena),
[he]-shines (bhāti)."

"Then-when (yadā-tadā)" — the-two-particles (nipātau), [and]-in-the-sentence-meaning-own-form-
reflection (vākyārthasvarūpaparāmarśe). "That-which-is-the-making-limited (yat parimitīkaraṇam),
[this]-is-the-saṃsāra-raising (saṃsārotthāpakaṃ), [and]-the-bewildering (mohanaṃ), [and]-the-
māyā-activity (māyāvyāpāraḥ)." "With-that-intention (tadabhiprāyeṇa)" — [i.e.]-having-the-saṃsāra-
delusion-in-view (saṃsāramoham abhipretya), [he]-connects (anusaṃdhatte), "by-the-object-ness
(viṣayatvena)" — [that]-which-was-said (yad uktaṃ), [and]-by-the-guru (guruṇā), [and]-by-that-
blessed-Vāsudeva (tatrabhavatā vāsudevena), toward-Arjuna (arjunaṃ prati):

> "And-whatever-[are]-the-sāttvika-beings (ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvāḥ), [and]-the-rājasa-and-the-
> tāmasa-which-are (rājasāstāmasāś ca ye); from-me-alone, here, know-them (matta eva iha tān
> viddhi)" — (Gītā 7.12)

— by-this (anena): "this-whole (sarvam idaṃ), [being]-of-the-known-form-and-the-knower-form
(vedyarūpaṃ vedakarūpaṃ ca), [and]-of-the-essence-of-the-manifestation-its-non-being-and-the-both-
mingling (prakāśatadabhāvatadubhaya-saṃvalanā-mayatayā), [and]-the-manifold (vicitram), [and]-from-
the-pure-own-nature-"I"-sensation-alone (aham-iti-śuddhasvabhāvād eva saṃvedanāt), [is]-sprung
(prasṛtam)" — [this]-having-said (abhidhāya): "and-from-the-primacy-of-the-division-manifestation
of-the-springing (prasarasya bhedāvabhāsaprādhānyāt), [and]-of-the-'I'-manifestation (ahaṃprakāśasya
ca), [and]-from-the-being-beyond-the-different-own-form-place-time (bhinnasvarūpadeśakālottaratvāt),
[and]-in-that-springing (tatra prasare), [and]-the-rooted (rūḍho), [and]-in-me, [and]-not-rooted
(mayi na rūḍho bhavati). For-of-the-springing (prasarasya hi), [and]-from-the-being-of-my-form
(madrūpatvāt), [and]-the-covering-part-alone (ācchādanabhāga eva), [are]-the-breaths (prāṇāḥ). But-
in-me (mayi tu), [and]-without-the-rooted-ness (rūḍhiṃ vinā), they-would-not-be-anything (te na
kiṃcit syuḥ), [and]-from-the-attainment-of-the-non-manifest-ness (aprakāśatvāpatteḥ); but-without-
them (na tu tair vinā), [and]-the-independent-"I"-manifestation (svatantrāhaṃprakāśasya), [and]-
the-refutation (khaṇḍanā), [and]-any (kācit), [is]-not (na)."

## The Brahman and the "all"

"With-the-saṃsāra-delusion-intention-alone (saṃsāramohābhiprāyeṇaiva), [and]-of-the-all-and-the-
Brahman (sarvabrahmaṇoḥ), what-is-to-be-commanded (kiṃ vidheyaṃ), what-is-to-be-repeated
(kimanuvaditavyam) — [this-is]-to-be-examined (vicārayitavyam)." There — "that-too
(tad-api), [and]-the-previously-established-Brahman (pūrvasiddhaṃ brahma), [and]-the-repeated
(anūdya), [and]-by-the-unprecedented-ness (apūrvatvena), [and]-the-all (sarvaṃ), [however], of-it,
[and]-of-the-known-knower-form (vedyavedakarūpaṃ), [is]-the-to-be-commanded (vidheyaṃ): 'the-Brahman-
alone-becomes-the-all (brahmaiva sarvaṃ bhavati), [and]-not-anything-else (nānyat kiṃcana); [and]-
the-all (sarvaṃ), [and]-the-Brahman, [is]-the-all-power (brahma kila sarvaśakti)' — [this-is]-the-
command-and-repetition (vidhyanuvādau)." "Even-so (tathāpi), of-the-other, the-to-be-taught
(parasya upadeśyasya), the-Brahman, [is]-not-anything-established (brahma na kiṃcit siddham), by-
which-[it]-is-repeated (yena anūdyate); but-the-all, of-it (sarvaṃ tu asya), [and]-of-the-known-
knower-form (vedyavedakarūpaṃ), [is]-established (siddham) — [so], that-[is]-repeated (tad-anūdya),
[and]-of-this, the-Brahman-identity (asya brahmatādātmyam), [is]-said (ucyate)."

"That-which-is-all-this-seen (yad sarvam idaṃ dṛśyate), of-it, [and]-the-inner-essence
(antastamāṃ svarūpam), [and]-entering-and-examined (anupraviśyavicāryamāṇaṃ), [and]-of-the-
manifestation-reflection-form-alone (prakāśaparāmarśa-rūpam eva), [and]-remains (avaśiṣyate). Hence-
[it]-was-said (tata uktam):

> "All-this, indeed, [is]-the-Brahman (sarvaṃ khalv idaṃ brahma)" — (Chāndogya 3.14.1)

Hence-alone, of-the-all-part (sarvabhāgasya), that-which-is-this-suspected (yad idaṃ śaṅkyate),
[and]-the-many-form (nānārūpaṃ), that-[is]-negated (niṣedhati):

> "...here, [there-is]-not-the-many, anything (neha nānāsti kiṃcana)" — (Chāndogya 3.14.1)

— here, in-the-seen (iha dṛśyamāne), [and]-of-the-"all"-word's-designate (sarvaśabdasya
vyapadeśye), [and]-which-[is]-not, with-the-manifestation (nānā yat prakāśena saha na bhavati), [and]-
by-the-manifestation-identity (prakāśatādātmyena), [and]-not-standing (na vartate), that-any-form
(tat kiṃcid rūpam), [is]-not (nāsti); from-the-non-comprehensibility (aprakāśamānasya), [and]-
even-by-the-oaths (śapathair api), [and]-the-not-to-be-known (apratyeyatvāt). For-the-oath, too
(śapatho'pi hi), [is]-the-effect-of-that-manifest-ness (tatprakāśatākāryo bhavati)."

**Objection (nanu):** "If-the-division-part-primacy-manifestation (bhedāṃśaprādhānyāvabhāsaḥ) [is]-
the-saṃsāra, then, of-the-its-base-being (tadbhittibhūtasya), the-manifestation-non-division-part
(prakāśābhedabhāgasya), in-the-primacy (prādhānye), why (kim iti)?" — [he]-says "of-the-agent-ness
(kartṛtāyāḥ), [and]-the-all-form-ness (vaiśvarūpyam)." "From-the-touch-of-the-pure-own-form
(śuddhasvarūpasparśaprārambhāt), [and]-by-the-Sadāśiva-Īśvara-form-ness (sadāśiveśvararūpatayā),
[and]-the-all-form-ness (vaiśvarūpam) — as-here-the-author-says (yathā iha granthakāra āha), so-
another-too-says (tathā anyo'pi āha); [or]-'that-manner, another-too-said (taṃ prakāram anyo'pi
āheti vā)', [or]-by-that, [and]-by-our-said-reason-manner (tena vā asmaduktena nyāyaprakāreṇa),
[and]-another-too (anyo'pi), 'this-he-said, that-he-said (etad āha, tadāha)' — [this]-being-such
(evaṃ), [and]-by-the-other-word (tathā cāha), [and]-the-agreement (saṃvādanaṃ), [and]-of-the-other-
word (vacanāntarasya vā), [and]-the-liveliness-making (sajīvatākaraṃ), [and]-the-not-other-meaning-
ness (ananyathārthatvaṃ), [and]-by-the-many-words (bhūyobhir vacanaiḥ), [is]-shown (darśyate)."

## The "I" and the all-pervading manifestation

"'Me (mām)' — the-"I"-form (ahaṃrūpaṃ), [and]-the-not-expecting-the-other (ananyāpekṣa), [and]-
the-manifestation (prakāśam), [and]-the-not-other-reflexion-made (ananyavimarśamayaṃ), [and]-the-
self-luminous-reflexion (svaprakāśavimarśaṃ), [and]-the-manifestation (prakāśaṃ), [and]-everywhere
(sarvatra), [and]-with-the-all-contact (sarvopaśleṣeṇa) — who-sees (yaḥ paśyati): 'the-blue'
(nīlam iti hi) — in-the-manifesting (prakāśamāne), 'the-blue-shines (nīlaṃ prakāśate)' — [this]-is-
the-'I'-in-the-manifestation (ity-ahaṃ prakāśe iti), [and]-the-manifestation-alone-[is]-made-
manifest (prakāśa eva prakāśito bhavati); [and]-the-manifestation (prakāśaṃ ca), [and]-everywhere,
[and]-who-sees (sarvatra yaḥ paśyati), [and]-of-the-manifestation (na prakāśasya), in-the-place,
the-time, the-own-form (deśe kāle svarūpe vā), [and]-the-refutation-self (khaṇḍanātmā), [and]-
the-cut-off (vyavacchedo'sti) — [not]."

"'In-me (mayi)' — in-the-self-sensation-manifestation (ātmasaṃvedana-prakāśe ca), [and]-that-not-
separated (tadavinirbhaktaṃ), [and]-the-all (sarvaṃ), [is]-made-manifest (prakāśitaṃ bhavati);
[and]-thus (tathā), [and]-the-blue-and-the-rest (nīlādikam), [and]-in-the-self-manifestation-base
(ātmaprakāśabhittau), [and]-rooted (rūḍhaṃ), [and]-shines (cakāsti) — who-sees (yaḥ paśyati)."

"Of-him (tasya), the-'I'-manifestation (aham iti prakāśo), [is]-not-destroyed (na praṇaśyati), [and]-
not-the-refutation-change (na khaṇḍanāvikāram), [and]-from-the-manifestation-form (prakāśarūpāt), [and]-
not-falls (eti na cyavate). And-I (ahaṃ ca), [and]-of-him (tasya), [and]-the-all-Lord-form-alone
(viśveśvararūpa eva), [and]-the-own-self (ātmā), [and]-not-I-destroy (na praṇaśyāmi), [and]-not-
covered-[am]-I (na ācchādito bhavāmi). And-so (tathā so'pi), [and]-such-a-seer (evaṃ draṣṭā), 'me
(mameti)', [and]-of-the-pure-manifestation-self (śuddhaprakāśātmanaḥ), [and]-of-the-Lord
(parameśvarasya), [and]-not-destroyed (na praṇaśyati), [and]-not-covered (ācchādito na bhavati);
there (tatra), [and]-the-Lord-alone (parameśvara eva), [and]-shines (bhātīti)."

"By-this (anena), [and]-in-the-Caitra-self (caitrātmanā), [and]-covered-own-nature-manifestation
ācchādita-svasvabhāvāvabhāsane), [and]-in-the-shining (nirbhāse), [and]-thus (iti evaṃ), [and]-he
(saḥ), [and]-by-the-inner-self-ness (pratyagātmatayā-api), [and]-not-separated (aviyuktaḥ), [and]-
the-Lord-alone (īśvaram eva), [and]-the-own-self (ātmānaṃ), [and]-considers (manyate). And-the-Lord
(parameśvaraś ca), [and]-there (tatra), [and]-by-the-concealed-ness-alone (pracchannatayaiva), [and]-
shines (cakāsti), by-which (yena), [and]-the-Lord, here, [and]-'is-gracious (parameśvaro'tra
prasīdatīti)' — [this-is]-the-practical-activity (vyavahriyate)."

## The all and the body-positions

"In-all-the-beings (sarveṣu bhūteṣu), [and]-of-the-supreme-real-form (paramārtharūpeṣu), [and]-
the-self (ātmā), [and]-the-manifestation (prakāśaḥ), [and]-stands (tiṣṭhati), like-the-universal-
in-the-particulars (viśeṣeṣv-iva sāmānyaṃ); [and]-all-the-beings (sarvāṇi bhūtāni), [and]-in-the-
self-alone (ātmany eva), [and]-stand (tiṣṭhanti), like-the-properties-in-the-property-possessor
(dharmā iva dharmiṇi) — thus (iti evaṃ), [and]-by-the-all-face, [and]-by-the-Brahman-face
(sarvamukhena brahmamukhena vā), [and]-by-the-equal-pervasion-made (samavyāptikakṛtakatva-anityatva-
nyāyena), [and]-of-the-command-and-the-repetition (vidhyanuvādayoḥ), [and]-the-not-variety (nāsti
vaicittryam). [And]-in-the-variety, too (vaicitrye'pi), [and]-the-being-difference (vastu bhedaḥ), [and]-
by-the-entry-variety (praveśavaicittryād), [and]-the-more (adhikaḥ)."

"Thus — 'in-me (mayi)' — [and]-the-all, [and]-the-Brahman — [this-is]-the-beginning (upakramaḥ);
'Vāsudeva-[is]-the-all (vāsudevaḥ sarvam)' — [this-is]-the-middle (madhyaḥ); 'in-all-the-beings-
[he]-stands (sarvabhūtastham)' — [this-is]-the-end (anto) — [this]-nondual-teaching
(advayopadeśaḥ), [is]-to-be-known (mantavyaḥ)."

"Thus, in-the-all-part, [and]-in-the-manifestation-part (sarvabhāge prakāśabhāge ca), [and]-
standing (sthite), [and]-the-quality-primacy-made (guṇapradhānatākṛtam), [and]-the-saṃsāra-non-
saṃsāra-form-ness (saṃsārāsaṃsāra-rūpatvaṃ), [is]-shown (pratipāditam). But-in-the-melted (galite
tu), [and]-the-whole-difference-particle (samaste bhedaleśe), [and]-the-supreme-Śiva-state
(paramaśivadaśā), [and]-here (iha), [and]-not-yet (na tāvat), [and]-is-spread (vitānitā), [and]-by-
the-all-self-form-ness (sarvātmarūpatāmukhena), [and]-from-the-beginning-of-the-recognition-of-
that (tatpratyabhijñānopakramāt)."

## The "own" (sva) and the self

**Objection (nanu):** "The-'self'-word-alone (ātmaśabda eva) —

> 'The-self (ātmā), [is]-the-thing (vastu), [and]-the-own-nature (svabhāvaḥ)...'

— [by]-this-stance (sthityā), [and]-as-the-own-nature-speaker (svabhāvavācī), [will]-be-explained
(vyākhyāyiṣyate): what, [then]-by-the-'own'-grasp (kiṃ svagrahaṇena)?" — [he]-says "the-'own'-word
(svaśabdaḥ)." "By-the-śāstra, first (śāstratas tāvat), [and]-in-the-Kāṇāda-and-the-rest-views
(kāṇādādidarśanaprasiddha eva), [and]-the-self (ātmā), [is]-obtained (labhyate); in-the-world, too
(loke'pi), [and]-the-own-nature (svabhāvo), [and]-of-the-blue-and-the-rest (nīlādīnāṃ), [and]-the-
blue-form-ness-alone (nīlādirūpataiva), [and]-'the-self (ātmā)' — [this-is]-well-known (prasiddhaḥ):
'the-blue, [and]-by-the-self (nīlam ātmanā), [and]-as-the-artha-kriyā-doer (arthakriyākāriṇā sat),
[and]-not-by-the-other-form (na pararūpeṇa)' — [and]-that-both (tad ubhayam-api), [and]-by-the-
'own'-word (svaśabdena), [and]-the-not-to-be-missed (avyabhicaraṇīyaṃ), [and]-from-the-being-the-
support-station (pratiṣṭhāsthānatvād), [and]-the-not-to-be-questioned (aparyanuyojyaṃ), [and]-the-
own-form (svarūpam), [and]-speaking (abhidadhatā), [is]-removed (nirasyate)."

**Objection (nanu):** "What-[is]-that-being-such-form (kiṃ tat tathābhūtaṃ rūpam)? For-thus
(tathāhi), [and]-of-all-the-beings (sarvabhāvānāṃ), [and]-the-atom-and-the-rest (paramāṇvādi vā),
[and]-the-principle (pradhānaṃ vā), [and]-the-being (sattā vā), [and]-the-void (śūnyaṃ vā), [and]-
by-the-other-view-advocates (vadyantarair upagataṃ), [and]-the-inert-alone (jaḍam eva), [is]-the-
own-form (svarūpam). That-[being]-specified (tad-viśeṣya), [and]-to-be-said (vaktavyaṃ), [and]-in-
the-consciousness-form-own-self (cidrūpe svātmani)" — [he]-says "of-that-and (tasya ca)."

"In-the-knower, the-agent (jñātari kartari)" — [this]-having-been-said (iti hi ukte), [and]-the-
knowledge-action-freedom (jñānakriyāsvātantryam), [and]-the-not-other-speech-seeing
(ananyavadana-avalokijāni-karomi), [and]-'I-know, I-do (jānāmi-karomi)' — [this]-being-such-form
(iti evaṃ-rūpaṃ), [and]-shines-indeed (sphuratyeva). "But-in-the-consciousness-form (cidrūpe iti),
[and]-being-said (tu ucyamāne), [and]-'the-blue-form (nīlarūpe)' — [with]-this-[it]-would-be-equal
(iti etat tulyaṃ syāt). And-hence (tataś ca), [and]-again (punar api), [and]-the-consciousness-form-
ness (cidrūpatvaṃ), [and]-into-the-knower-agent-ness (jñātṛkartṛtvayoḥ), [is]-to-be-transferred
(saṃkrāmayitavyam)."

"This-alone (iyam eva) — [and]-from-the-being-the-mere-negation-of-the-'this'-designation
(idantāvyapadeśanikāra-mātratvāt), [and]-first (tāvat), [and]-the-own-self (svātmā), [is]-to-be-
preserved (rakṣaṇīyaḥ); there (tatra), [and]-by-the-'knower, the-agent'-utterance (jñātā karteti
apy ukter), [and]-the-outside-resting-place-self (bahirviśrāntidhāmatā), [and]-the-own-self
(ātmā), [and]-as-the-to-be-told (vidheyatvena), [and]-the-'this'-ness-alone (idantaiva), [is]-
unfolded (unmīlet). 'He-knows, he-does (jānāti karoti)' — [and]-'he-is-white, he-is-blue'
(śvetate nīlatīti-vat), [and]-the-indifference (tāṭasthyam); [and]-'I-know (jānāmī)' — [and]-the-
conceived-I-ness (kalpitā ahantā)."

"And-not-in-every-way-[is]-the-'this'-ness-to-be-preserved (naca sarvathā rakṣitum idantā śakyā),
[and]-from-the-attainment-of-the-not-teachable-ness (anupadeśyatā-prasaṅgāt) — [so], as-far-as-the-
going (yāvadgati), she-[is]-to-be-preserved (sā rakṣaṇīyā). There (tatra), [and]-in-the-connection-
with-the-being-tense (bhūtavibhaktiyoge), [and]-the-outside-primacy-lowering (bahiḥ prādhānyanyakkāro),
[and]-in-the-inner-form-rest (ntārūpaviśrānter), [and]-the-'I'-being-touch-form (ahaṃbhāvasparśarūpo),
[and]-shines (bhātīti) — [this], in-the-relation-investigation (saṃbandhavicāre), [will]-be-said
(vakṣyate) — [this-is]-the-'only'-word-meaning (evakārārthaḥ)."

## The "good" (śreyas) and the grammar

"In-the-good (śreyasi)" — [i.e.]-in-the-not-repeated (anūdyamāna), [and]-in-the-other-view-
undertaking, too (aparomatopakrame'pi), this-is-the-meaning (ityarthaḥ). "Hence, indeed (ata eva)."
"Because (yato), in-the-knowledge-and-the-action (jñāne kṛtau ca), [and]-the-freedom-alone
(svātantryam eva), [is]-the-consciousness-ness (cittvam); hence (tataḥ), [and]-by-the-'agent'-word
(kartṛśabdena), [and]-the-not-derived (avyutpannena), [or]-by-the-action-universal-speaking
(kriyāsāmānyābhidhāyikarotiprakṛtikena vā), [and]-the-action-particular-condition-connection-
impurity-not-mounted (kriyāviśeṣopādhisaṃbandhakāluṣyānārūṣitam), [and]-the-freedom
(svātantryam), [and]-speaking (abhidadhatā), [and]-the-on-that-base-attached (tadbhittilagnaṃ), [and]-
the-knowledge-freedom (jñānasvātantryam), [and]-by-the-word-play (śleṣeṇa ca), [and]-the-maker-ness's-
(the-non-separateness (nirmātṛttvasya tadavinābhāvitāṃ), [and]-to-show (darśayituṃ), [and]-by-the-
effort-taken (yatnaparigṛhītena), [and]-that-preceded (tatpūrvakaṃ), [and]-in-the-making
(nirmāṇe), [and]-the-freedom (svātantryam), [is]-said (uktam)."

"Otherwise (anyathā)" — "if-this-pure-freedom-establishing-intention (yadi eṣa śuddhasvātantrya-
pratipādanābhiprāyo) [were]-not (na syāt), [then]-the-knowledge-preceded-making (jñānapūrvakaṃ
nirmāṇaṃ), [is]-seen (dṛṣṭam); [and]-of-the-consciousness-form (saṃvidrūpasya), [and]-the-cause-ness
(kāraṇatvaṃ), [will]-be-refuted (dūṣayiṣyate); [and]-not-that-making (naca tat nirmāṇam), [and]-
thus (iti), [and]-'in-the-knower (jñātari)' — [and]-before (prāk), [and]-not-[is]-it-pointed-out
(na nirdiśyeta)."

**Objection (nanu):** "Thus — 'I-know, I-do (jānāmi karomīti)', [and]-in-the-fit-manifestation
(ucitapratibhāse), [and]-the-free-one-form (svatantraikarūpe), [and]-in-the-sensation-self-truth
(saṃvedanātmani tattve), how (katham), [and]-the-substratum-being (adhikaraṇabhāvaḥ)? For-the-
dependence-lived (pāratantryaprāṇitaṃ hi), [and]-of-the-other-agents (kārakāntarāṇāṃ), [is]-the-
truth-ness (tattvam). 'From-me-the-world, in-me-the-world (matto viśvaṃ mayi viśvam)' — in-this-
and-the-rest, too (ityādāv-api hi), [and]-the-created (sṛṣṭa eva), [and]-our-meaning (asmadarthaḥ);
[and]-the-supreme-real-I-form (pāramārthikamahantārūpaṃ), [however], 'from-me, in-me, [is]-the-world
(matto mayi viśvam)' — [and]-in-the-manifestation (iti prakāśe), [and]-'I-reflect (vimṛśāmi)' — [and]-
being-such-form (iti evaṃ-rūpam). That-how-the-seventh (tat kathaṃ saptamī)?" — to-this-suspicion,
[he]-says "by-the-other-view (paramatena)."

"For-the-other (paro hi), [and]-that-subject (tadviṣayaṃ), [and]-the-establishing-or-refuting
(sādhakaṃ bādhakaṃ vā), [and]-speaking (abhidadhat), [and]-the-establishment (siddhim), [and]-
'[it]-exists (astīti)', [and]-the-manifestation-practical-activity-form (prakāśavyavahārarūpāṃ), [or]-
the-negation (niṣedhaṃ vā), '[it]-is-not (nāstīti)', [and]-that-void-other-thing-manifestation-
practical-activity-form (tacchūnyavastvantara-prakāśa-vyavaharaṇarūpaṃ), [is]-about-to-do
(kartum udyuktaḥ). He, [and]-thus-doing (sa evaṃ kurvāṇaḥ), [and]-of-the-means-of-knowledge
(pramāṇasya), [and]-of-the-two-made-by-it, the-establishment-and-the-negation (tatkṛtayoś ca
siddhiniṣedhayor), [and]-as-the-subject (viṣayatayā), [and]-the-Lord (īśvaraṃ), [and]-the-to-be-
known (prameyaṃ), [and]-the-dependent-alone (paratantram eva), [and]-considers (abhimanyate). He,
[and]-thus-thinking (sa evaṃ manvānaḥ), [and]-the-repeated (anūditaḥ), [and]-the-inert-ness
(jāḍyaṃ tu), [and]-of-this (asya), [is]-commanded (vidhīyate). By-the-other-view, [and]-the-
establishment-subject-ness (siddhiviṣayatvaṃ), [is]-indicated (sūcitaṃ); [and]-not-[is]-it-possible
(nahi upapadyate), [and]-from-the-being-one-form-with-the-knower (tat pramātrekarūpatvād) — [this]-
[is]-the-word-connection (akṣarasaṃgatiḥ)."

**Objection (nanu):** "In-the-vṛtti-book (vṛttigranthe), how-[is]-the-seventh-not-heard (kathaṃ na
saptamī śrutā)?" — [he]-says "in-the-vṛtti, though (vṛtau tu), [and]-that-alone (sa eva)." "[The]-
not-possible-being (anupapadyamāna eva san), [and]-the-subject-being (viṣayabhāvaḥ), [is]-to-be-
explained (vivarīṣyate), [and]-by-the-sixth (ṣaṣṭhyā). That-very-establishment (tāmeva siddhiṃ),
[and]-by-the-relation-ness (saṃbandhitvena), [and]-inside-entering (antaḥpraveśya), [and]-by-the-
sixth (ṣaṣṭhyā), [and]-that-very-subject-being (sa eva viṣayabhāvaḥ), [and]-by-the-action-interval-
hiding (kriyāvyavadhi-tirodhānataḥ), [and]-to-the-own-nature-conceived-ness (svabhāvakalpatāṃ),

"And-thus-he-says (tathā ca āha): 'hence (ata eva).' Because — 'the-freedom (svātantryam), [is]-the-

the-self-sensation-established-ness-of-this (svasaṃvedanasiddhatvam asya), [and]-to-speak
(vaktum ucitaṃ), [and]-not-in-every-way (natu sarvathaiva), [and]-the-not-subject-of-the-means-of-
knowledge (pramāṇāviṣayatā)" — [he]-says "and-not (naca)."

**Objection (nanu):** "Even-in-the-prior-established-ness (pūrvasiddhatāyām-api), [and]-first

[he]-says "this-is-said (etaduktam iti)." "When-when-[is]-the-beginning (yadā yadā upakramaḥ),
then-then-[is]-the-prior-established-ness (tadā tadā pūrvasiddhatvam) — [this]-here (eṣo'tra), [is]-
the-supreme-meaning (paramārthaḥ)." "That, [and]-in-the-blue (tat nīle iva), [and]-not-here (na atra), [and]-
the-separate-means-of-knowledge (vyatiriktaṃ pramāṇaṃ); [and]-not (nāpi), [and]-like-the-
consciousness-consciousness-ness (cittacaitanyavat), [and]-in-the-self-luminous-ness, too
(svayaṃprakāśatve'pi), [and]-the-new-unprecedented-manifestation-form-ness (nūtanāpūrva-prakāśa-
rūpatvena), [and]-the-self-sensation (svasaṃvedanam)..."

---

## T1 apparatus — the key decisions (Chunk C)

1. **svātmā → "the own-self"** — the "own" (sva) is the self's own form (the non-other-expecting);
   the inert things have no own-self, so the self-as-Lord is theirs too.
2. **the Upaniṣadic cross-check** — Abhinava cites Chāndogya 3.14.1 ("sarvaṃ khalv idaṃ brahma,"
   "neha nānāsti kiṃcana") and the space-portions analogy (ghaṭākāśa/paṭākāśa) to align with the
   Vedānta — but the Śaiva reading: the Brahman is the manifestation-reflexion (prakāśa-parāmarśa).
3. **the Gītā 7.12** — the sāttvika/rājasa/tāmasa beings are all "from me" — Abhinava reads it as:
   the whole known-knower manifold is sprung from the pure "I"-sensation.
4. **the māyā-śakti** — the Lord's own power, concealing-while-manifesting; the Sadāśiva/Īśvara
   state (uncovered) vs the māyā-unfolding (the saṃsāra-state).
5. **the body-as-covering** — the body (kāya) is where the limited "I" is plunged; the Rudra/
   kṣetrajña/knower forms.
6. **the jñātṛ-kartṛ (knower-agent)** — the identity of knowing and doing; the "I know, I do"
   (jānāmi-karomi) as the freedom. The "one" word refutes the object-ness (dependence), not the
   agent-ness.
7. **the "I" as all-pervading manifestation** — who sees the "I"-manifestation everywhere, in
   place, time, own-form, without division — his "I" is the all-Lord's own self, not covered.
8. **the seventh/sixth-case grammar** — the "in some way" (kathaṃcit) + the substratum; the
   subtle case-analysis of the sūtra's syntax.
9. **svasaṃvedana → "self-ascertainment/self-sensation"** — the self-luminous cognition that
   knows itself, without a separate means-of-knowledge.

**The crux:** the self as the all-pervading manifestation. The "I" that shines everywhere —
without division into place, time, own-form — is the Lord's own self; the body-and-the-rest are
its coverings (the māyā). The knower-agent identity (jñātṛ-kartṛ) is the freedom. Abhinava aligns
this with the Vedānta (Brahman = all) but grounds it in the manifestation-reflexion (prakāśa-
vimarśa), and the grammar of the sūtra is analyzed with precision. This is the heart of the
nondual claim: the self is the all, and the "I" is the Lord.

# IPVV Vol 1 — Chunk D: the memory, the eternal knower, the pramāṇa/karaṇa — T1

*Source: M00020 lines 1800–2400 (continuous). Base: Torella's ĪPK. Covers: the Rāmāyaṇa/Vālmīki
example (memory of a past time proves the eternal knower), the Gītā 2.12, the apūrvaprakāśatva
(the non-unprecedented-manifestation), the pramāṇa/karaṇa (means/instrument), the sense-organ
(indriya) as instrument, the svasaṃvedana (self-sensation), and the non-constructive/constructive
distinction. Max-effort T1.*

---

## The Rāmāyaṇa and the eternal knower

"At-the-time-of-the-Rāma-descent (rāmāvataraṇakāle), 'I-was-not' (nāhamabhūvam)" — even-this
(ityapi hi), [and]-of-that-time (tasya kālasya), [and]-the-experience (anubhavaḥ), [is]-to-be-said
(vaktavyaḥ). "From-the-āgama, [and]-the-knowledge-of-that-time (āgamāt tatkālajñānam)" — if-it-
is-so (iti cet), the-āgama, too (āgamo'pi), [and]-of-the-speaker, the-experiencer (vaktur
anubhavituḥ), [and]-the-experience (anubhavam), [and]-implies (ākṣipati); [and]-by-that-experiencer,
first (tadanubhavitrā tāvad), [and]-is-to-be (bhāvyam)."

**Objection (nanu):** "Vālmīki, [and]-by-that (vālmīkistāvatā), [and]-the-experiencer, [is]-
established (anubhavitā siddhaḥ), not-we-and-the-rest (na asmādādiḥ)." [This-is]-in-place (sthāne),
the-question (praśnaḥ); but (kintu), [and]-of-the-sensation-self (saṃvedanātmano), [and]-the-"I"-
reflexion (ahaṃvimarśasya), [and]-the-so-much-ness (tāvadiyatā), [and]-the-always-being
(sadbhāvaḥ), [and]-the-eternal (sadātanaḥ), [is]-established (siddhaḥ). And-he-alone, [and]-the-
supreme-real-knower (eka eva paramārthapramātā); if-the-other-breath-intellect-eight-made-body-
and-the-rest (yadi paraprāṇabuddhipuryaṣṭakaśarīrādayo bhinnāḥ), [and]-by-that-difference-made
(tadbhedakṛtaś ca), [and]-the-knower-difference-practical-activity (pramātṛbhedavyavahāraḥ) —
then (iti), "that-body-and-the-rest (tat śarīrādi), [and]-today's (adyatanaṃ), [and]-in-that-time,
[was]-not (tasmin kāle nābhūd)" — this, here, [is]-the-truth (etad atra tattvam). "At-the-time-of-
the-dissolution (pralayakāle), [and]-at-the-beginning-of-the-creation-face (sṛṣṭimukhārambhe ca),
[and]-we-were-not (na vayaṃ vabhūvima)" — [otherwise], [and]-the-time-particular-recollection
(kālaviśeṣollekho), [and]-would-not-be (na syāt). "We-were-not (vayaṃ na vabhūvima)" — [and]-even-
in-this (ity-api atra), [and]-in-the-cognition (pratītau), [and]-the-perfect-tense-ending-brought
(liṭpratyayāntar-nīta), [and]-the-past-time-manifestation (bhūtakālāvabhāsaḥ), [and]-flashes
(unmiṣatyeva). For-this-[is]-a-cognition (nahi iyaṃ na pratītiḥ); and-the-cognition (pratītiś ca),
[and]-not-of-the-experience-form (na anubhavarūpā iyaṃ), [and]-in-that-being-thus (tathātve), [and]-
like-the-yogin, [and]-now (yogina iva idānīṃ), [and]-of-the-past-time-object (pūrvakālaviṣayasya),
[and]-the-clarity-manifestation (sphuṭatāpratyavabhāsaḥ), [and]-would-follow (prasaṅgāt). This, [and]-
being-the-memory (tad iyaṃ smṛtir eva bhavantī), [and]-the-prior-experience, [and]-implies-alone
(pūrvānubhavam ākṣipatyeva). Even-being-the-conjecture (utprekṣāpi bhavantī), [and]-the-recollection,
[or]-the-experience (smaraṇaṃ anubhavaṃ vā), [and]-from-the-root (mūlato'valambate); [and]-not,
[and]-like-the-entry-into-the-blind-darkness (nāndhatamasānupraveśa iva), [and]-the-conjecture,
[and]-would-be-possible (utprekṣā saṃbhavet). Only (kevalaṃ), [and]-of-the-pure-sensation-alone
(śuddhasaṃvedanamātrasya), [and]-from-the-non-contact-with-time (kāloparāgaśūnyatayā), [and]-from-
the-non-possibility-of-the-other-thing-manifestation (svarūpavyatirekivastvavabhāsāsaṃbhavena ca),
[and]-the-animated-by-both (tadubhayānuprāṇitarūpā), [and]-the-memory (smṛtiḥ), [and]-not-possible

[is]. And-the-prior-body-contact (prācyaśarīroparāgaś ca), [and]-from-this-body-contact-different

sphuṭīkārā), [and]-from-the-not-possible (ayogāt), [and]-not-clearly (na sphuṭaṃ), [and]-the-memory-
ness (smṛtitvam), [and]-in-the-attained-infancy-position (atiśiśutāpadānabhūte iva), [and]-of-the-
youth (yūnaḥ).

For — [and]-by-the-experiencer-ness (anubhavitṛtvena hi), [and]-where-the-pride (yatra abhimāno),
[and]-deep-in-the-body (gāḍhaḥ śarīre), there-alone (tatraiva), [and]-from-the-non-fall-of-the-one-

enough-of-the-much (alam bahunā). This-[is]-established (sthitam etat): "not, [and]-of-the-self

"By-the-non-unprecedented-ness (apūrvatvam)" — [is]-the-being (sattayā). "By-the-non-unprecedented-
manifestation-ness (apūrvaprakāśatvam)" — [is]-by-the-attainment (adhigamena). And-here, [and]-
this-meaning (atra cārtho), [is]-to-be-known (mantavyaḥ). Hence-indeed (ata eva), [he]-divides

and-not, [and]-of-the-being, too, [and]-the-experience (naca sato'pi anubhavaḥ)." In-truth
(vastutastu), [and]-the-being, too (sattāpi), [and]-in-the-manifestation-rest (prakāśaviśrāntaiva) —
hence (iti), [and]-the-being-prior-ness (sattāpūrvyaṃ), [and]-in-the-manifestation-non-unprecedented-

the-co-reference-alone (sāmānādhikaraṇyam eva), [is]-fit (yuktam). [And]-the-"let-one-understand
(pratipadyatām)" — [and]-the-"and (ca)"-word, [is]-not-used (na prayuktaḥ).

## The non-unprecedented manifestation and the knower

"The-knower-gone (pramātṛgato), [and]-the-non-unprecedented-manifestation-practical-activity
(apūrvaprakāśatvavyavahāraḥ), [and]-first (prāk), [and]-in-the-non-being-of-the-knower
(pramāturasadbhāve), [and]-not-[is]-born (na bhavati), [and]-from-the-expectation-of-the-prior-time-
recollection-dependent-on-the-knower-and-the-cognition (pramātṛpramāyattapūrvakālasmaraṇāpekṣatvāt).
[And]-in-its-non-being (tadasadbhāve), [and]-the-being-of-the-becoming's-pervader
(bhavanasya vyāpakaṃ), [and]-that-dependent-form-not-expecting-ness (tadāyattarūpānapekṣatvaṃ), [and]-
like-the-cloth-in-the-non-being-of-the-clay-ball (paṭasya iva mṛtpiṇḍābhāve). [And]-the-opposed-to-

[and]-this-is-the-pervader-opposed-perception (vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ)."

## The knowledge and the manifestation

"Hence (tasmāt), [and]-by-the-blue, [and]-first (nīlena tāvat), [and]-to-be-manifested (prakāśitavyaṃ prathamam). And-the-manifestation (prakāśanaṃ ca), [and]-of-this (asya), [and]-in-the-supreme-real-knower-Śiva (paramārthapramātari śive), [and]-'I (aham)' — [and]-in-the-Sadāśiva-ground (sadāśivabhūmā), [and]-the-'this'-part, [and]-unclear-ness (vidamaṃśāsphuṭatayā), [and]-'I-this (aham idam)' — [and]-in-the-Īśvara-earth (īśvarabhuvi), [and]-the-clear-'this'-part (sphuṭedamaṃśena), [and]-'I-this (aham idam)' — [and]-this-much (ity etāvān), [and]-the-knowledge-power-alone-manifestation (jñānaśaktimātram avabhāsaḥ). [And]-in-this-much-ground (iyatyāṃ bhūmā), [and]-of-the-'this'-part (vidamaṃśasya), [and]-the-separate-ness-alone (pṛthaktaiva), [and]-is-not (nāsti), [and]-the-I-ness (ahantā) — hence (tataḥ), [and]-like-the-mirror-alone (darpaṇādiva), [and]-of-the-blue (nīlasya); hence (tataḥ), [and]-in-the-separate-unfolding (pṛthaktvollāse'pi), [and]-the-not-separately (apṛthaktayā), [and]-like-the-consciousness-of-the-body (caitanyādiva dehasya). [And]-this (eṣā), [and]-the-knowledge-ground (vidyābhūmir), [is]-said (ucyate). And-here, too (atrāpi ca), [and]-by-the-mantra-Lord-mantra-difference (mantramaheśvara-mantrabhedena), [and]-the-inner-difference (avāntaro bhedaḥ), [and]-in-the-āgama-section (āgamādhikāre), [and]-will-be-spread (vitaniṣyate)."
